265.description: Every 10 hits of Expertise Skill allows Ice Crystal Core to fire Ice Arrow (triggers up to once every 0.5s).

266.name: Intellect Ice Crystal
266.description: Every 50 Intellect grants 1 Max Ice Energy, up to 100 from this source.

267.name: Quick Chant
267.description: Increases Haste by 2500. During [Permafrost (#1515)], Casting SPD increases by 15%.

268.name: Sharp Ice Arrow
268.description: Ice Arrows from Ice Crystal Core are guaranteed to Crit. Increases the Crit DMG of Ice Arrows from Ice Crystal Core by 10%.

269.name: Ray's Swan Song
269.description: When dealing DMG, [Frostbeam (#1509)] gains a fixed 10% chance to double Mastery for 3s (which can only be triggers once on multiple hits).

301.name: Swift Turn
301.description: For every 1% Haste, gains 1% Attack SPD.

302.name: Infernal Combo
302.description: When Special Attacks or Basic Attacks deal damage, grants [Infernal Combo (#1211)] (triggers only once when hitting multiple targets).

303.name: Crimson Lotus
303.description: Gain adaptive effects when [Infernal Combo (#1211)] reaches max stacks: Formless Spec: ATK +8%. Crimson Spec: Crimson Recovery effect +10%.

304.name: Crimson Flame Pursuit
304.description: Special Attack hits cause the target to take +2.5% DMG. The effect lasts 8s and stacks up to 3 times.

305.name: Wild Soul - Break
305.description: When Strength reaches 500 points, Expertise Skill damage +5%.

306.name: Crimson Lotus Duality
306.description: Each stack of [Infernal Combo (#1211)] grants effects based on the relationship between Luck Chance and Crit Chance: When Luck Chance is greater than or equal to Crit Chance, each stack of [Infernal Combo (#1211)] grants 1.6% Lucky Strike Multiplier. When Crit Chance is greater than Luck Chance, each stack of [Infernal Combo (#1211)] grants 1.2% Crit DMG.

307.name: Flame Soul Seal
307.description: Flame Soul cap +50. Every 50 Flame Soul gained triggers [Infernal Combo (#1211)].

308.name: Wild Soul - Swift
308.description: When Strength reaches 300 points, the effect of the talent [Infernal Combo (#1211)] is increased by 50%.

310.name: Crimson Lotus Ember Epiphany
310.description: While in the [Infernal Combo (#1211)] state, the [Flame Suppression (#1218)] effect is increased by 50%.

311.name: Soaring Crimson Flame Pursuit
311.description: Enhances Crimson Flame Pursuit based on the target's lost HP: When the target's HP is below 80%, enhances the base effect by 30%. The lower the target's HP, the higher the bonus, up to a maximum enhancement of 100% when the target's HP drops to 30%.

312.name: Formless Expertise Spec
312.description: By using different Special Attacks and Expertise Skills, the Formless level can be raised from E to S (a total of 6 levels). During its 8s duration, each 1 level grants [Blazing Assault (#1622)], [Rage Cleave (#1623)], and [Axe Wind (#1624)] a 2% CD Speed increase. Trigger Formless effects to accelerate CDs, chain Blazing Assault to boost Expertise Skill DMG, and combine with the core Formless Flame Slash mechanic to deal massive combo DMG.

313.name: Blazing Pact
313.description: After casting [Blazing Assault (#1622)], the next Expertise Skill deals +20% Final DMG, but its Crit Chance is halved.

314.name: Soaring Flame
314.description: After gaining Formless 6 times or activating [Wasteland's End (#1625)], [Blazing Ascension (#1619)] evolves into [Soaring Flame (#1620)]. Gains [Blaze (#1620)] after casting [Soaring Flame (#1212)].

315.name: Time Wheel Rewind
315.description: When Formless is obtained, the remaining CD of the skill with the longest current CD among [Blazing Assault (#1622)], [Rage Cleave (#1623)], and [Axe Wind (#1624)] is reduced by 1.5s.

316.name: Inferno
316.description: In [Blaze (#1212)] state, Expertise Skills inflict [Burn (#1213)] when they hit a target.

317.name: Inferno Explosion
317.description: When a target is inflicted with [Burn (#1213)], there is a 30% fixed chance to accumulate 1 stack of Wildfire that lasts for 10s. When Wildfire reaches 12 stacks, it triggers [Explosion (#1214)] and clears Wildfire stacks.

318.name: Lucky Explosion
318.description: [Burn (#1213)] can trigger Lucky Strike. Based on the target's current [Burn (#1213)] stacks, increases [Explosion (#1214)] damage. Each additional 1 stack of [Burn (#1213)] increases [Explosion (#1214)] damage by 5%.

319.name: Wasteland Raid
319.description: During [Wasteland's End (#1625)], triggering a Lucky Strike with [Rage Cleave (#1623)] or [Axe Wind (#1624)] reduces the charge time of [Blazing Assault (#1622)] by 1s.

320.name: Time Wheel Lucky Soul
320.description: Each 1 level of the Formless effect increases Lucky Strike DMG by 2%.

321.name: Time Wheel Agile Soul
321.description: Each 1 level of the Formless effect grants 2.5% Strength.

322.name: Returning Soul
322.description: [Blazing Assault (#1622)] restores 5% of lost Flame Soul. When Formless is at S level, enhances recovery effect to 10%.

323.name: Double Inferno
323.description: [Axe Wind (#1624)] applies 3 stacks of [Burn (#1213)] to hit targets. At S Formless level, targets hit by [Axe Wind (#1624)] accumulate 1 stack of Wildfire that lasts for 10s. When Wildfire reaches 12 stacks, it triggers [Explosion (#1214)] and clears Wildfire stacks.

324.name: Hellfire Meteor
324.description: In the Formless S-Rank state, each cast of [Rage Cleave (#1623)] summons 1 [Hellfire Meteor (#1215)] at the primary target's location.

326.name: Wasteland Finale
326.description: Gains 25% Fire Bonus for 15s after casting Ultimate.

327.name: Expertise Formless Flame Slash
327.description: [Rage Cleave (#1623)], [Blazing Assault (#1622)], and [Axe Wind (#1624)] can trigger [Formless Flame Slash (#1216)].

328.name: Formless Flame Slash Luck
328.description: Every 1% Luck increases the trigger chance of [Formless Flame Slash stages 1 to 3 by 0.2%/0.1%/0.05% respectively, but the Crit Rate of Formless Flame Slash (#1216)] is halved.

329.name: Formless Combo
329.description: For every 5 hits an Expertise Skill deals to the main target, it grants a buff that increases the Lucky Strike Multiplier by 27% and reduces Lucky Strike Crit Rate by 20% for the next 8s. This effect stacks up to 3 times.

330.name: Formless Flame Slash - Break
330.description: [Formless Flame Slash (#1216)] can trigger Lucky Strike. Lucky Strike DMG Multiplier +5%. Every 1% Luck grants 0.8% Lucky Strike DMG Multiplier.

333.name: Formless Flame Slash Attack Break
333.description: Basic Attacks, [Blazing Ascension (#1619)], and [Soaring Flame (#1620)] can trigger [Formless Flame Slash (#1216)].

334.name: Lucky Blade Combo
334.description: Expertise Skills ignore 35% of the target's Armor.

335.name: Formless Flame Slash Combo
335.description: Each 1 level of the Formless effect provides 2% [Formless Flame Slash (#1216)] DMG.

337.name: Instant Wasteland
337.description: When Formless is obtained, the remaining CD of [Wasteland's End (#1625)] is reduced by 0.5s or its duration is extended by 0.5s (total extended duration cannot exceed 5s).

338.name: Burning Attack
338.description: Fire Bonus +8% when attacking Elite or higher targets.

339.name: Varied Strikes
339.description: For each additional target hit by an Expertise Skill, DMG dealt +10%, up to 60%.

340.name: Flame Soul Attack Spirit
340.description: When killing a target, Flame Soul +5.

341.name: Stellar Spark
341.description: Expertise Skill DMG increases Fire ATK by 22 for the next 10s. Stacks up to 10 times.

342.name: Crimson Expertise Spec
342.description: Gains the Crimson Recovery effect: When hitting the main target (excluding [Wildfire Dance (#1626)]), 20% of the DMG dealt is converted into Crimson Soul Gauge (Crimson Soul Gauge value cannot exceed Max HP). When Flame Soul is insufficient, 25% of the Crimson Soul Gauge value can be consumed to extend the duration of [Wildfire Dance (#1626)] by 0.8s. Build the gauge quickly through Crimson Recovery, then leverage high Attack SPD to trigger Wildfire Dance frequently. Use this as the core mechanic and combine it with other skill effects to unleash massive DMG within the burst window.

343.name: Soul Flame
343.description: For every 10% Crimson Soul Gauge charged, immediately gains a buff: Increases ATK bonuses from all sources by 2% for 5s. This effect can stack up to 3 times.

344.name: Raging Flame Sharpness I
344.description: For every 10% Max HP or Crimson Soul Gauge lost, a stack of a buff is immediately gained: Crit Chance from all sources is increased by 2.5% for 5s. This effect can stack up to 3 times.

345.name: Crimson Earth - Flame Soul
345.description: While within Crimson Earth, Flame Soul recovery efficiency +30%. While within Crimson Earth, [Wildfire Dance (#1626)] DMG +50%.

346.name: Crimson Earth - Swift
346.description: Every 1% Attack SPD increases the Crimson Recovery effect by 1% while within Crimson Earth.

347.name: Crimson Earth Meteor I
347.description: Every 2 casts of [Unbound Meteor (#1627)] cause [Unbound Meteor (#1627)] to evolve into [Falling Hellfire (#1628)].

348.name: Raging Flame Sharpness II
348.description: Every 1% Haste grants 0.5% Expertise Skill CD Boost.

349.name: Crimson Earth Meteor II
349.description: [Unbound Meteor (#1627)] and its enhanced skill ([Falling Hellfire (#1628)]) gain 15% Fire Bonus. This is increased by an additional 15% within Crimson Earth.

350.name: Destined Meteor
350.description: Casting [Flowing Splendor Slash (#1630)], [Unbound Meteor (#1627)], and its enhanced skill ([Falling Hellfire (#1628)]) consumes up to 2 stacks of [Infernal Combo (#1211)]. Each stack of [Infernal Combo (#1211)] grants that skill a 10% Fire Bonus.

352.name: Hellfire Manifestation
352.description: While [Endless Hellfire (#1629)] is active, the Crimson Recovery effect is doubled and the final consumption of the Crimson Soul Gauge is reduced by half.

353.name: Crimson Focus
353.description: For every 1% Attack SPD exceeding 30%, 0.2% Expertise Skill DMG is provided.

354.name: Flowing Splendor Rotation
354.description: After casting [Flowing Splendor Slash (#1630)], [Wildfire Dance (#1626)] DMG is increased by50% for 5s. [Flowing Splendor Slash (#1630)] charge count +1.

355.name: Instant Flowing Splendor
355.description: When [Frenzied Slash (#1621)] deals DMG, there is a 15% fixed chance to grant [Flowing Splendor Slash (#1630)] 1 charge and cause its next cast to consume no Flame Soul.

356.name: Ultimate Hellfire
356.description: Activating [Endless Hellfire (#1629)] immediately grants 5 stacks of [Infernal Combo (#1211)], which are not consumed while it is active. [While Endless Hellfire (#1629)] is active, Strength +15%.

357.name: Crimson Crit
357.description: When Crimson Soul Gauge is charged above 50%, Fire ATK +50%.

358.name: Crimson Pierce
358.description: When dealing Crit DMG, ignores 22% of the target's Armor.

359.name: Unbound Meteor Combo
359.description: [Falling Hellfire (#1628)] is enhanced into a continuous three-hit strike form. Every 1% Crimson Soul Gauge increases [Falling Hellfire (#1628)] DMG by 1%.

360.name: Crimson Epiphany
360.description: Every 1% Mastery grants 2% Crimson Recovery final effect.

361.name: Wildfire Dance Final Slash
361.description: After [Wildfire Dance (#1626)] deals Crit DMG 10 times (hits on multiple targets count as one), it triggers a Final Slash that deals 500% ATK as Attack DMG to enemies. [Each Crit DMG instance dealt by Wildfire Dance (#1626)] grants the Final Slash a 3% Final DMG Bonus (up to a maximum of 100%).

362.name: Wildfire Formless Flame Slash
362.description: [Wildfire Dance (#1626)] can trigger [Formless Flame Slash (#1216)], but can no longer trigger Lucky Strikes. [The damage multiplier of Formless Flame Slash (#1216)] is adjusted to the skill multiplier that triggered it * (30% + Crit%).

363.name: Wild Slash Combo
363.description: Each time [Wildfire Dance (#1626)] deals DMG 1 time, it grants the next [Unbound Meteor (#1627)], [Falling Hellfire (#1628)], or [Flowing Splendor Slash (#1630)] a 2.5% Final DMG Bonus (up to a maximum of 100%). Casting any of these skills clears this bonus.

364.name: Arcane Wildfire Bloodline
364.description: When [Wildfire Dance (#1626)] deals DMG, there is a fixed chance of 12% + Haste% / 2.5 to gain 1 stack of Crimson Bloodline. When Crimson Bloodline reaches 7 stacks, it triggers [Great Crimson Lotus (#1217)] and clears all Crimson Bloodline stacks.

366.name: Arcane Raging Flame
366.description: Every 15% Crimson Soul Gauge charged reduces the remaining CD of [Endless Hellfire (#1629)] by 0.5s. Every 10% of Haste reduces it by an additional 0.1s, up to 1s.

400.name: Swift Shadow
400.description: Every 50 points of Courage consumed reduces the CD of [Spiral Thrust (#1523)], [Breach Pursuit (#1522)], and [Falcon Toss (#1524)] by 1s.

402.name: Vulnerable Strike
402.description: Dealing DMG grants a fixed 30% chance to apply Vulnerability to the enemy. Vulnerability: Increases the DMG you deal to the target by 10% for 5s.

403.name: Sharp
403.description: Dealing DMG with Special Attacks grants [Sharp (#1152)].

405.name: Wind Rift Diffusion
405.description: Expertise and Ultimates deal 10% more DMG to targets inflicted with [Rend (#1153)], and when hitting [Rend (#1153)] targets, deal 1 additional hit of 75% DMG.

406.name: Wind Tear
406.description: When [Gale Thrust (#1517)] deals DMG, apply [Rend (#1153)] to targets.

407.name: Quickshot Meteor
407.description: [Gale Thrust (#1517)] is enhanced, increasing hit counts by 2. Reduces [Gale Thrust's (#1517)]Courage consumption by 20%.

410.name: Swift Blade
410.description: When [Valor Cyclone (#1518)] deals DMG, it has a fixed 7% chance to evolve Basic Attacks into [Swift Blade (#1592)].

411.name: Zephyr Waltz Agility
411.description: Additional Courage recovery: Recovers 1 extra point of Courage per second for every 2 stacks of [Sharp (#1152)].

412.name: Wind Chaser
412.description: During the casting of [Valor Cyclone (#1518)], for every 20 points of Courage consumed, increase the DMG of [Valor Cyclone (#1518)] by 4%, up to 20%.

413.name: Vortex Strike
413.description: After every 2 casts of [Drake Cannon (#1591)], your [Spiral Thrust (#1523)] evolves into [Vortex Strike (#1590)].

414.name: Instantaneous Crit
414.description: While [Chasing Step (#1157)] is active, [Instant Edge (#1519)] and [Sharp Impact (#1521)] have their Crit Chance doubled. Additionally, for [Instant Edge (#1519)] and [Sharp Impact (#1521)], every 1% excess Crit is converted into 3% Crit DMG for the respective skill.

416.name: Spear Thrust
416.description: When [Skyfall (#1520)] lands a Lucky Strike, it triggers [Spear Thrust (#1156)], once every 2s. Dealing DMG with [Spear Thrust (#1156)] restores 8 points of Courage. This effect triggers only once, even if multiple targets are hit.

419.name: Air Dance Strike
419.description: [Sharp Impact (#1521)] and its enhanced skill ([Typhoon: Sharp Impact (#1159)]) increase the Courage restored by the next [​Galeform​ (#1553)] by 50%. Casting [Sharp Impact (#1521)] immediately grants 3 [Sharp (#1152)], and casting its enhanced skill [Typhoon: Sharp Impact (#1159)] immediately grants 6 [Sharp (#1152)].

421.name: Tornado Dance
421.description: During [Wind Fury (#1187)], DMG dealt by [Instant Edge (#1519)] and [Azure Sever (#1589)] triggers [Tornado (#1158)] (triggered at most once when hitting multiple targets).

422.name: Chasing Step
422.description: When [Skyfall (#1520)] or [Falcon Toss (#1524)] deals a Crit or Lucky Strike, they trigger [Chasing Step (#1157)]. When [Skyfall (#1520)] or [Falcon Toss (#1524)] trigger a Crit and Lucky Strike simultaneously, they grant 2 stacks of [Chasing Step (#1157)].

423.name: Divine Wind Support
423.description: When [Falcon Toss (#1524)] and its enhanced skill ([Azure Sever (#1589)]), or [Instant Edge (#1519)] hits 1 target, the DMG gains a 10% Wind bonus.

424.name: Combat Expertise
424.description: As the battle goes on, grants continuously increasing ATK. Every 10s, ATK +2.5%, up to 10%. Cleared after battle.

425.name: Momentum Surge
425.description: Increases [Sharp (#1152)] effect by 1%, and for each enemy within 12m, additionally increases by 1%, up to 3%.

427.name: Catcher
427.description: In combat, for every 1 enemy target defeated (party-wide effect), ATK +65 for 30s, up to 650.

428.name: Wind Split Technique
428.description: When [Rend (#1153)] deals DMG, it has a fixed 50% chance to grant 2 points of Courage.

429.name: Tempestrike
429.description: When [Galeform (#1553)] ends, it applies the [Tempestrike (#1179)]. Every 50 points of Courage or 3 points of Sharp consumed during [Galeform (#1553)] extends the duration of [Tempestrike (#1179)] by 1s.

430.name: Divine Concealment
430.description: Consuming Courage increases Haste by 1% and Speed by 2% for 5s, stacking up to 5 times.

432.name: Skyward Spec
432.description: Replaces Special Attack with [Skyfall (#1520)] and enhances the skill. When having [Sharp (#1152)], gains ATK based on the max number of [Sharp (#1152)]. Skyfall and Instant Edge can chain together, skipping the aerial cast delay. High Luck and critical rate enable Skyfall to trigger a low-cost Instant Edge.

433.name: Vanguard Spec
433.description: Further enhances [Gale Thrust (#1517)]. Casting [Gale Thrust (#1517)] grants a 20% fixed chance to cause Basic Attacks to evolve into [Swift Blade (#1592)], with an additional 5% chance per stack of [Sharp (#1152)]. Maximize Courage gain and expenditure to reduce the CD of Expertise skills. Haste increases Courage generation and the casting speed of core Expertise skills.

434.name: Battle Cry
434.description: [Typhoon Cleave (#1525)] raises the banner spear, granting Inspire to allies and increasing the caster's Crit DMG by 50% for 10s. Afterward, a follow-up leap can be launched, dealing Attack DMG to the enemies within range and knocking them airborne, while restoring 100 Courage. Inspire: Lasts for 10s. All allies gain 10% Haste (only one effect can be active at a time). You restore 10 Courage per second and 1 [Sharp every 2s (#1152)].

437.name: Long Lance Sharp Blade
437.description: When Strength reaches 300 points, Expertise Skill damage +7%.

438.name: Sharp
438.description: When Strength reaches 500 points, the additional ATK from [Sharp (#1152)] increases to 6%.

439.name: Break Pursuit Advancement
439.description: Within 15s after Casting the Ultimate, Casting [Breach Pursuit (#1522)] will not start CD. This effect is removed after the duration ends or after Casting 3 times [Breach Pursuit (#1522)].

440.name: Wind Spiral
440.description: When [Gale Thrust (#1517)] deals DMG, it has a fixed 50% chance to grant 1 stack of Wind Spiral for 20s, stacking up to 10 times. Wind Spiral: When casting [Spiral Thrust (#1523)] or [Valor Cyclone (#1518)], it triggers a Spiral Explosion, dealing Attack DMG equal to Wind Spiral stacks x 200% ATK to nearby enemies. Each 1% of Mastery increases this DMG multiplier by 7%, up to 560%. This DMG cannot Crit, and decreases by 5% for each additional target hit, down to a minimum of 25%. Triggering this clears all Wind Spiral stacks.

441.name: Vigor Spike
441.description: When [Sharp (#1152)] reaches full amount and the caster is in combat, enters [Vigor Spike (#1155)] state, effective up to once every 30s (affected by CD Boost stats).

442.name: Fearless Gale
442.description: After casting [Spiral Thrust (#1523)] or [Breach Pursuit (#1522)] or [Valor Cyclone (#1518)], the next [Gale Thrust (#1517)] will not consume Courage. This effect is removed after leaving combat.

443.name: Whispering Breeze
443.description: When Courage is below or equal to 50%, reduces the Energy [Valor Cyclone (#1518)] consumes by 2. When Courage is above 50%, increases the DMG [Valor Cyclone (#1518)] deals by 12%.

444.name: Rapid Drake Cannon
444.description: Using [Swift Blade (#1592)] grants it a fixed 10% chance to evolve Basic Attack into [Drake Cannon (#1591)] in 10s. Each failure to evolve increases the chance by 10% until success.

445.name: Rupture
445.description: When [Valor Cyclone (#1518)] deals DMG, it has a fixed 50% chance to inflict [Rupture (#1154)].

446.name: Spiral Tear
446.description: [Spiral Thrust (#1523)] and [Vortex Strike (#1590)] deals 30% more DMG to the targets with [Rend (#1153)].

447.name: Fortitude
447.description: During [Valor Cyclone (#1518)], gains [Super Armor (#1102)] and reduces DMG taken by 20%. When [Valor Cyclone (#1518)] deals DMG, restores HP equal to 10% ATK.

448.name: Swift Breeze
448.description: Each 1% Haste accelerates the REG SPD of Courage by 2%.

449.name: Breath of Wind
449.description: Skills that consume Courage ([Spiral Thrust (#1523)] and its enhanced skills, [Valor Cyclone (#1518)], [Falcon Toss (#1524)] and its enhanced skills, [Gale Thrust (#1517)]) gain 6% Wind Bonus.

450.name: Wind Rise
450.description: When [Valor Cyclone (#1518)] deals DMG, increases [Drake Cannon (#1591)] and [Vortex Strike (#1590)] Crit Chance by 7%, and Crit DMG by 5%. The effect lasts 5s and stacks up to 7 times.

451.name: Strong Attack
451.description: When [Valor Cyclone (#1518)] deals DMG, reduces the CD of Ultimate by 0.5s (which can only be triggers once on multiple hits).

452.name: Spiral Flame
452.description: Using [Vortex Strike (#1590)], increases Haste by 25% for 10s.

453.name: Dragon's Fury Flame
453.description: The Crit chance of [​Drake Cannon​ (#1591)] and [​Vortex Strike​ (#1590)] is doubled. Increases the Crit DMG of [Drake Cannon (#1591)] and [Vortex Strike (#1590)] by 8%. Each 1% Haste grants 0.5% Crit DMG for [Drake Cannon​ (#1591)] and [​Vortex Strike​ (#1590)].

454.name: Wind Gate Drake Cannon
454.description: Every 22 triggers of [Valor Cyclone (#1518)] allows Basic Attack to evolve into [Drake Cannon (#1591)] in 10s.

455.name: Bird Advancement
455.description: Increases the charge of [Falcon Toss (#1524)] by 1. Reduces Courage consumed by [Falcon Toss (#1524)] by 50%.

456.name: Sharp Advancement
456.description: Enhances the effectiveness of [Wind Fury (#1187)] by 50%. When [Instant Edge (#1519)] consumes [Chasing Step (#1157)], doubles the charge efficiency of [Sharp Impact (#1521)].

457.name: Spear Recovery
457.description: [Spear Thrust (#1156)] reduces the CD of [Falcon Toss (#1524)] by 2s (which can only be triggers once on multiple hits).

458.name: Sharp Long Breath
458.description: During [Wind Fury (#1187)], [Falcon Toss (#1524)] evolves into [Azure Sever (#1589)] once.

460.name: Skyfall
460.description: When dealing DMG, [Skyfall (#1520)] gains a fixed 15% chance to grant 1 stack of [Sharp (#1152)].

461.name: Pursuit Power
461.description: [Chasing Step (#1157)] consumed increases Strength by 15%. The effect lasts 10s and stacks up to 2 times.

462.name: Exceptional Elegance
462.description: During [Galeform (#1553)], increases the DMG dealt by [Instant Edge (#1519)] and [Skyfall (#1520)] by 25%.

463.name: Typhoon: Sharp Impact
463.description: [Sharp Impact (#1521)] is enhanced, evolving into [Typhoon: Sharp Impact (#1159)].

464.name: Instant Edge Break Style
464.description: [Instant Edge (#1519)] consumes 1 more [Sharp (#1152)]. Increases the DMG dealt by [Instant Edge (#1519)] by 90%.

465.name: Wind Swirl Strike
465.description: Increases the DMG dealt by [Tornado (#1158)] by 30%. Increases the DMG dealt by [Spear Thrust (#1156)] by 30%.

466.name: Sharp Pursuit
466.description: When [Instant Edge (#1519)] consumes [Chasing Step (#1157)], grants 1 stack of [Sharp (#1152)].

467.name: Instant Edge Combo
467.description: [Instant Edge (#1519)] has a fixed 25% chance to trigger one extra instance of DMG (if Lucky Strike chance exceeds 25%, that becomes the new trigger chance). This extra DMG equals [Instant Edge (#1519)] DMG x current Lucky Strike DMG multiplier%, and is affected by all relevant [Instant Edge (#1519)] DMG bonuses.

468.name: Break Style
468.description: When dealing Crit DMG, Expertise Skill ignore the targets' 50% Armor.

469.name: Sharp Echo
469.description: If [Sharp (#1152)] isn't at Max stacks, increases the DMG dealt by [Skyfall (#1520)] by 25%.

470.name: Kamikaze Luck
470.description: For each 1 stack of [Sharp (#1152)] consumed, gains 3 points of Courage. Increases Lucky Strike final DMG by 50%.

501.name: Intellect Conversion
501.description: Every 10 points of Intellect provides 1 point of MATK.

502.name: Inspiration
502.description: Applies [Inspiration (#1107)] to yourself and allies within 30 meters.

503.name: Regen Bud
503.description: Casting a Special Attack grants 1 [Regen Bud (#1108)]. Initial cap of [Regen Buds (#1108)]: 4. When an Expertise Skill or Ultimate generates healing, 2 [Regen Buds (#1108)] are consumed to throw a [Nourishing Seed (#1115)], triggering up to once per second. When an Expertise Skill or Ultimate deals DMG, 2 [Regen Buds (#1108)] are consumed to shoot a [Wild Seed (#1116)], once per second.

505.name: Nature Shield
505.description: When [Wild Bloom (#1526)] heals a target, it also applies [Nature Shield (#1111)] to them. Targets with [Nature Shield (#1111)] restore HP when hit, with the amount equal to 10% of your ATK. This effect can occur up to once per second.

506.name: Arcane of Green
506.description: When [Feral Seed (#1529)] deals DMG, it increases [ATK by Mastery % x Luck % (#1530)] for the next 10s.

507.name: Healing Breath
507.description: When a Special Attack, Expertise Skill, or Ultimate generates Healing, there is a 20% to trigger [Healing Chain (#1109)]. For every 2% Luck, the chance +1%.

508.name: Wild Blessing
508.description: [Wild Bloom (#1526)] now holds up to 2 charges. [Wild Bloom (#1526)]'s Energy cost -15%.

509.name: Flourish
509.description: When [Infusion (#1530)], [Feral Seed (#1529)], or [Wild Bloom (#1526)] deals DMG, 30% chance to reduce the CD of the Ultimate by 1s, once per second.

510.name: Smite Spec
510.description: Further enhances the ability to use [Wild Bloom (#1526)]. [Wild Bloom (#1526)], [Regen Pulse (#1532)], and [​Nature Ward​ (#1535)] grant Symbiotic Mark to allies. Symbiotic Mark: Lasts for 10s. All of the caster's DMG will heal allies with Symbiotic Mark for 45% of the DMG dealt. Increases the final DMG of Lucky Strikes by 50%. When overhealing a target with Symbiotic Mark, if the overheal reaches 30% of their Max HP, the excess healing is converted into a regeneration effect lasting for 10s. This effect can trigger only once every 30s. Healing of Stillness: If the caster deals no DMG to enemies for 5s, each hit of the caster's Basic Attack will heal up to 10 allies (party members prioritized), with the 4-hit combo restoring 12.6% Max HP in total. After using an Ultimate, Basic Attacks immediately start healing, but this effect is disabled upon dealing DMG to enemies. Capable of converting attacks into healing. Lucky Strikes from attacks trigger various healing effects, enhancing healing while increasing DMG dealt.

511.name: Double Infusion
511.description: After casting [Stag Charge (#1593)], the number of channels for the next [Infusion (#1530)] +100%.

512.name: Final Bloomwheel
512.description: When [Wild Bloom (#1526)] deals DMG, reduces the remaining CD of [Infusion (#1530)] by 1s. If the DMG triggers a Lucky Strike, the remaining CD is reduced by 3s.

514.name: Verdant Root
514.description: While in battle state, standing still for 2s creates a Grass Domain. Grass Domain: While inside the Grass Domain, your Haste +10%. Upon exiting the Grass Domain, your Movement SPD +50% for 0.5s, and Grass Domain disappears.

515.name: Full Bloom
515.description: Casting [Life Bloom (#1527)] grants a 40% chance to reduce the remaining CD of [Blossom Charge (#1533)] and [Nourish (#1528)] by 2s. Each 1% of Mastery increases this chance by 0.4%, up to a maximum of 60%. Casting [Life Bloom (#1527)] grants a 50% chance to reduce the remaining CD of [Fast Growth (#1583)] by 0.2s, triggering at most once every 10s. Each 20% of Haste increases the CD reduction by 0.1s, up to a maximum of 0.5s.

516.name: Healing Infusion
516.description: Every 5 uses of [Life Bloom (#1527)] enhances the next direct healing Expertise Skill by 100%.

518.name: Verdant Duet
518.description: [Life Bloom (#1527)] has a fixed 20% chance to heal 1 additional time.

519.name: Floral Whisper
519.description: Healing Expertise generate 20% more healing, but healing from [Life Bloom (#1527)] -50%.

520.name: Lifeforce Extension
520.description: Increases the Healing of [Healing Chain (#1109)] by 10%. For every 7% Mastery, [Healing Chain (#1109)] jumps 1 additional time. [Healing Chain (#1109)] restores 1% of an ally's Max HP with each tick.

521.name: Nourish Essence
521.description: When [Life Bloom (#1527)] generates healing, 50% chance to apply [Nourish (#1528)].

522.name: Endless Blossom
522.description: When casting [Blossom Charge (#1533)], [Grove Wish (#1534)], or [Regen Pulse (#1532)], 20% chance that the next cast of [Life Bloom (#1527)] within 5s consumes no Energy.

523.name: Stag Charge
523.description: After triggering a total of 10 [Nourishing Seeds (#1115)] or [Wild Seeds (#1116)], [Wild Bloom (#1526)] evolves into [Stag Charge (#1593)]. Casting [Stag Charge (#1593)] instants grants 3 [Regen Buds (#1108)].

524.name: Wings of Revival
524.description: When an ally within 20 meters takes DMG exceeding 30% of their HP, Revival triggers, which can affect the same target up to once every 45s. Revival: Restores HP equal to 50% of the DMG taken over 5s.

525.name: Natural Bloom
525.description: When healing an ally with lower than 30% HP, Natural Bloom triggers, instantly restoring HP equal to 200% ATK to them. This effect can occur up to once every 30s.

526.name: Healing Pulse
526.description: When an enemy within 10 meters that you are engaged with is defeated (effective within a team), generates a [Healing Pulse (#1110)]. This can only occur once every 10s.

527.name: Gift of Life
527.description: When an enemy within 10 meters that you are engaged with is defeated (effective within a team), generates a [Healing Orb (#1113)]. This can only occur once every 2s.

528.name: Bud Acquisition
528.description: When an enemy within 10 meters that you are engaged with is defeated (effective within a team), generates an [Engram Orb (#1114)], which grants 1 [Regen Bud (#1108)] upon pickup.

529.name: Defensive Blessing
529.description: [Inspiration (#1107)] provides the target with an additional 400 Armor.

530.name: Flowers Ascension
530.description: When [Wild Seed (#1116)] deals DMG or [Nourishing Seed (#1115)] generates healing, you gain a 10% Forest DMG bonus for the next 8s.

531.name: Lifebind Spec
531.description: Replace Special Attack with [Life Bloom (#1527)] and enhances the skill. [Life Bloom (#1527)] generates 20% more healing. Casting [Life Bloom (#1527)] grants 1 additional [Regen Bud (#1108)]. Whenever safety allows, aim to cast as many healing skills as possible. Haste increases cast speed, and Mastery enhances healing potency.

532.name: Thorn
532.description: When [Wild Seed (#1116)] hits a target, it inflicts [Thorn (#1117)] on them. Forest DMG dealt by players to targets with [Thorn (#1117)] +20%.

533.name: Vital Surge
533.description: Replace Ultimate, [Divine Circle Bloom (#1531)] with [Vital Surge (#1551)].

534.name: Verdant Blessing
534.description: When HP of an ally with [Inspiration (#1107)] drops below 20%, Blessing triggers. Blessing: Grants a [Nature Shield (#1111)] and reduces the DMG taken by 35% for 8s, once every 60s.

536.name: Dancing Seed
536.description: When a DMG-type Expertise Skill triggers Lucky Strike, next [Wild Seed (#1116)] launches 1 more projectile. For every 5 [Nourishing Seeds (#1115)] thrown, next [Nourishing Seed (#1115)] throws 1 more projectile.

537.name: Energy Surge
537.description: Every 2% haste provides 1% energy natural recovery efficiency.

538.name: Regeneration Bud
538.description: When dealing damage with Basic Attacks, 10% chance to gain 1 [Regen Bud (#1108)].

540.name: Shelter
540.description: Within 5s after Casting [Infusion (#1530)], the damage absorption of the [Nature Shield (#1111)] added by [Wild Bloom (#1526)] or [Nature Ward (#1535)] is doubled.

541.name: Pulse Breath
541.description: If equipped with [Regen Pulse (#1532)] skill, [Nature Ward (#1535)] and Ultimates will trigger [Regen Pulse (#1532)] when their CDs are completed.

542.name: Feral Seed Symbiosis
542.description: When active Symbiotic Marks reach 5 or more, [​Feral Seed​ (#1529)] and [Wild Seed (#1116)] DMG increases by 100%.

543.name: Wild Protection
543.description: The charge count of [Nature Ward (#1535)] +1. The charge time of [Nature Ward (#1535)] decreases by 5s.

544.name: Wide-area Thorns
544.description: Successful hit of [Feral Seed (#1529)] on the targets with [Thorn (#1117)] spreads [Thorn (#1117)] to other units within 10 meters. Attacking Elite or stronger targets grants 8% Forest Bonus.

545.name: Thornbreaker
545.description: [Infusion (#1530)] and [Stag Charge (#1593)] deal 100% more Final DMG to [Thorned (#1117)] targets (each 1% of Mastery grants an additional 4%), but the healing conversion of [Infusion (#1530)] and [Stag Charge (#1593)] is halved.

546.name: Pulse Duality
546.description: When [Regen Pulse (#1532)] is actively used, it spreads twice.

547.name: Swift Shelter
547.description: Each use or trigger of [Regen Pulse (#1532)], reduces the CD of [Nature Ward (#1535)] by 2s.

548.name: Pulse Retrospect
548.description: [Regen Pulse (#1532)] returns to your position after it reaches the max distance. [Regen Pulse (#1532)] now deals DMG to enemies.

549.name: Swift Bud
549.description: Each [Regen Bud (#1108)] gained, reduces the CD of [Feral Seed (#1529)] by 1 second.

550.name: Breath of Symbiosis
550.description: Symbiotic Mark increases converted healing by 2%. Each 5% Mastery grants an additional 1%. Symbiotic Mark also grants 2% Max HP for 5s (duration cannot be refreshed when reapplied).

551.name: Symbiosis Extension
551.description: Each [Wild Seed (#1116)] fired extends the duration of activated Symbiotic Mark by 1s.

552.name: Pulse Echo
552.description: When dealing DMG, [Infusion (#1530)] grants 1 stack of Pulse Echo. Pulse Echo: Increases DMG dealt of [Regen Pulse (#1532)] by 20%, which lasts 12s and stacks up to 5 times.

553.name: Luck Damage
553.description: Lucky Strike DMG Multiplier +5%. Every 1% Luck grants 1.5% Lucky Strike DMG Multiplier.

554.name: Verdant Impact
554.description: For every 20 stacks of Pulse Echo gained, the next actively cast [Regen Pulse (#1532)] triggers a [Blossom Charge (#1533)] at both the nearest enemy and the Ally with lowest HP.

555.name: Wild Luck
555.description: When [Wild Bloom (#1526)] or [Regen Pulse (#1532)] deal DMG, grants a chance (equal to the half percentage of Luck) to gain 1 [Regen Bud (#1108)]. If the target is affected by [Thorn (#1117)], doubles the chance.

556.name: Verdant Nourishment
556.description: If you're affected with [Nourish (#1528)], reduces all DMG taken by 10%. If the targets are affected by [Nourish (#1528)], enhances their Healing Received from yourself by 5%. If the stack of [Nourish (#1528)] is above or equal to 3, additionally enhances Healing Received by 3%.

558.name: Life Bloom
558.description: Using [Blossom Charge (#1533)] enhances the next [Life Bloom (#1527)], skipping the cast and increasing the Healing by 50%.

559.name: Vitality
559.description: [Nourish (#1528)] can stack up to 5 times. Each use of [Life Bloom (#1527)] grants the targets with [Nourish (#1528)] 1 stack of [Nourish (#1528)].

560.name: Flourishing Progress
560.description: When holding 2 or more [Regen Buds (#1108)], casting [Blossom Charge (#1533)] for damage or healing always triggers a corresponding seed (without costing [Regen Buds (#1108)]) and grants 1 [Regen Bud (#1108)].

561.name: Blooming Reincarnation
561.description: Casting [Life Bloom (#1527)] increases [Life Bloom (#1527)]'s healing by 20% and its Energy consumed by 10% for 4s. This effect can stack up to 5 times.

562.name: Energy Arcane
562.description: During [Fast Growth (#1583)], increases Energy REG SPD by 50%. Increases [Grove Wish (#1534)]'s Crit by 10%

564.name: Flourishing Flower
564.description: Within Grass Domain, Flower Stalk appeared 50% earlier.

565.name: Tricolor Revelation
565.description: Consumes [Moonlight Solace (#1121)] to launch Flower Dance - Tricolor Revelation. Flower Dance - Tricolor Revelation: Grants all effects of Flower Stalks, once every 60s.

566.name: Flower Time Dance
566.description: Every 45s, generates 1 Flower Stalk in the following order: [Crimson Insight (#1119)], [Golden Devotion (#1120)], and [Moonlight Solace (#1121)].

567.name: Bud to Blossom
567.description: When a Flower Stalk appears, grants 1 [Regen Bud (#1108)] every 2s for 10s.

568.name: Inspire and Strengthen
568.description: [Inspiration (#1107)] grants 135 bonus Intellect, Strength, Agility, and Endurance.

569.name: Energy Expansion
569.description: Increases Max Energy by 20. Using [Blossom Charge (#1533)] restores 30% lost Energy.

570.name: Rescue
570.description: Healing Expertise Skill restore 25% more HP to the targets with HP below 50%.

571.name: Instant Bloom
571.description: Every 5 uses of [Life Bloom (#1527)] accelerates the using of [Grove Wish (#1534)] or [Regen Pulse (#1532)] by 100% and increases their Healing by 50% in 15s.

900.name: Stone Fragment Tide
900.description: For 8s after you cast [Cracking Echo (#1536)], each Basic Attack pulls a target between 8 and 20 meters away toward you. The same target cannot be pulled again within 3s.

903.name: Weakness Strike
903.description: When dealing DMG, Basic Attacks have a fixed 10% chance to trigger [Weakness Strike (#1123)] once.

906.name: Block Recovery
906.description: Successful [Block (#1170)] restores 1% of your HP and 2 Rage. This can only occur once per second. Triggering [Lucky Block (#1126)] restores 2% of your HP and 4 Rage. This can only occur once per second.

907.name: Countercrush
907.description: A successful [Block (#1170)] triggers a [Countercrush (#1125)], once per second. On a [Lucky Block (#1126)], randomly triggers 1 to 3 [Countercrush (#1125)], once per second.

911.name: Rock Heal
911.description: [Stone Fist (#1597)] restores 5% max HP. For every 1 extra enemy hit, restores an additional 2% max HP (up to a total of 15%. Excess healing is converted into an equivalent Shield.

914.name: Slam Shelter
914.description: A successful hit with [Shield Bash (#1540)] reduces the target's DMG dealt to you by 3% for 10s, stacking up to 3 times.

916.name: Resolute Breath
916.description: While shielded, use Basic Attack midair to slam down, detonating the shield and dealing damage equal to 30% max HP to nearby enemies.

917.name: Smash Support
917.description: Increases the effectiveness of Shield granted by [Shield Bash (#1540)] by 30%.

918.name: Sandy Shelter
918.description: During [Stoneform (#1542)], every 20 Rage gained triggers [Sandy Shelter (#1168)].

919.name: Shield Combo
919.description: Basic Attacks have a fixed 5% chance to trigger [Shield Combo (#1127)] upon dealing DMG. Each 1% Mastery grants an extra 0.2% chance.

920.name: Breath of Stone
920.description: Each Sand Crystal consumed reduces the CD of [Stoneform (#1542)] by 1s.

921.name: Elemental Harmony
921.description: While shielded, MATK Reduction +10%. Each 1% of Mastery increases this effect by 0.5%, up to a maximum of 40%.

922.name: Shield Echo
922.description: During [Sandshroud (#1541)], adding a shield to yourself via [Shield Bash (#1540)] triggers [Shield Echo (#1128)].

923.name: Shattering Rageblow
923.description: When dealing DMG, [Granite Fury (#1539)] has a 20% chance to allow your next Basic Attack to evolve into [Rageblow (#1169)]. Each 2% Luck adds 1% chance. After casting [Rageblow (#1169)], increases [Block (#1170)] DMG Reduction by 10% for 10s.

925.name: Survival Instinct
925.description: When HP falls below 30%, triggers [Survival Instinct (#1129)], once every 60s.

926.name: Shadow Veil
926.description: Each enemy within 3 meters increases your [Block (#1170)] chance by 3%, up to 15%. (Doubles the effect against Elite or stronger enemies.) Remains unchanged when Earthfort Spec is active. If Block Spec is activated, the effect becomes: Every enemy within 3 meters increases [Block (#1170)] DMG Reduction by 1%, up to 5%. (Doubles the effect against Elite or stronger enemies.)

927.name: Valiant Fury
927.description: When [Enraged (#1135)], you gain 30% bonus Armor, decreasing by 5% per second.

928.name: Group Suppress
928.description: Each enemy within 3 meters enhances the effectiveness of [Suppress (#1122)] by 3%, up to 15%. This effect is doubled against Elite or stronger enemies.

929.name: Rage Awakening
929.description: Consuming Rage has a chance to enter [Enraged (#1135)] state for 5s. The more Rage you consume, the higher the chance. Each Rage increases the chance by 1%.

930.name: Block Spec
930.description: Replaces Special Attack with [Countercrush (#1538)], and enhances the ability. When [Lucky Block (#1126)] triggers, increases Block DMG Reduction by 10%. Try to keep Countercrush active as much as possible. While it's active, part of incoming DMG can be blocked. High Luck allows parry to yield various buffs.

931.name: Earthfort Spec
931.description: Further enhances the ability to use [Shield Bash (#1540)]. Each additional enemy hit increases the damage dealt by [Shield Bash (#1540)] by 30%, up to 150%. When attacked, increases All-Element Resistance by 0.6% for 4s, stacking up to 10 times. Each 1% Mastery increases this effect by 2%. Maintain shield uptime whenever possible. Besides reducing incoming damage, the shield also applies certain effects when active.

932.name: Resonant Domain
932.description: [Cracking Echo (#1536)] generates a [Sandfield (#1137)] that lasts for 5s.

933.name: Sandstone Rewind
933.description: When [Rageblow (#1169)] deals DMG, it reduces the CD of [Brave Bastion (#1543)] by 3s. Casting [Brave Bastion (#1543)] immediately restores 50% Max HP. Any excess healing is converted into a shield that lasts 10s.

934.name: Sandstone Shock
934.description: During [Brave Bastion (#1543)], casting [Countercrush (#1538)] or [Granite Fury (#1539)] triggers [Sand Crystal Shock (#1136)].

935.name: Block Blessing
935.description: A successful [Block (#1170)] grants a fixed 30% chance for your next [Granite Fury (#1539)] cast to consume no Sand Crystals. This effect can occur up to once every 3s.

938.name: Enrage Delay
938.description: When Strength reaches 500, extends the duration of [Enraged (#1135)] by 1 second.

939.name: Sandstone Revival
939.description: For each 1 Sand Crystal consumed, restore 1% of Max HP.

941.name: Rage Burst improvement
941.description: The charge count of [Rage Burst (#1544)] +1. While [Enraged (#1135)], [Rage Burst (#1544)] and [Terra Sunder (#1134)] become instant cast.

942.name: Star Fury
942.description: Increases [Star Shatter (#1537)] and [Starfall (#1594)] DMG by 30%, and guarantees [Enraged (#1135)] status.

943.name: Stone Domain
943.description: Throughout the duration of [Sandshroud (#1541)], being attacked reduces the attack speed of enemy targets within a 5 meter radius by 30% for 3s. throughout the duration of [Sandshroud (#1541)], Armor of allies within an 8 meter radius +10%.

944.name: Amplified Earthfort
944.description: Upon the triggering of [Weakness Strike (#1123)], gains [Amplified Earthfort (#1124)].

945.name: Boulder Shield
945.description: During [Stoneform (#1542)], reduces all DMG taken by 10%.

946.name: Shield Bash
946.description: Enhances Shield effectiveness by 10%. During [Sandshroud (#1541)], additionally enhances Shield effectiveness by 10%.

947.name: Recovery
947.description: Each successful hit of Expertise Skill or Special Attack increases Strength by 1% in 5s. The effect stacks up to 10 times. With 10 stacks, increases Strength by 10% for 8s. During this effect, the next Expertise Skill heals you for 20% of the DMG dealt, yet no additional Strength stacks can be gained.

948.name: Starfall
948.description: For every 20 Sand Crystals consumed, [Star Shatter (#1537)] evolves into [Starfall (#1594)].

949.name: Rock Master
949.description: Casting [Starfall (#1594)] grants Rock Master. Rock Master: For 15s, Basic Attack evolves into 1 [Rupture (#1595)], and [Rage Burst (#1544)] evolves into 1 [Terra Sunder (#1134)]. When Rock Master activates, grants 10% Rock Bonus for 10s.

950.name: Shatter Strike
950.description: When [Star Shatter (#1537)] or [Starfall (#1594)] defeats a target, [Star Shatter (#1537)]immediately recovers 1 charge.

951.name: Enraged Rupture
951.description: While [Enraged (#1135)], [Rupture (#1595)] is bound to trigger [Weakness Strike (#1123)].

952.name: Bash Pursuit
952.description: Every 50 times damage is taken, the next [Shield Bash (#1540)] deals additional fixed damage equal to 100% HP + 300% of current shield amount (shield amount cannot exceed 150% Max HP). Can trigger at most once every 20s. Every 2% of Mastery reduces the required times of damage taken by 1. Every 1% of Versatility reduces the trigger interval by 1% (up to 50%).

953.name: Great Rock Master
953.description: Casting [Stoneform​ (#1542)] grants Rock Master: For 15s, Basic Attack evolves into 1 [Rupture (#1595)], and [Rage Burst (#1544)] evolves into 1[ Terra Sunder (#1134)].

954.name: Bravery in Battle
954.description: While in combat, overhealing is converted into a shield (total shield cannot exceed 50% of Max HP).

955.name: Rock Guard
955.description: Armor +5%. Each attack of [Terra Sunder (#1134)] deals an additional instance of Attack DMG to the target, equal to 100% Armor.

956.name: Rampart Fury
956.description: When you take DMG, [Lucky Block (#1126)] reduces DMG taken by 2%, lasting for 8s, stacking up to 3 times.

957.name: Block Shelter
957.description: [Granite Fury (#1539)] DMG enhances [Lucky Block (#1126)] DMG Reduction by 2% for 8s. Stacks up to 3 times.

958.name: Sand Block
958.description: Successfully [Blocking (#1170)] has a fixed 20% chance to gain 1 Sand Crystal. If it was a [Lucky Block (#1126)], gain an additional 1 Sand Crystal.[ (#1170)]

959.name: Rock Heart
959.description: Every 10 casts of [​Granite Fury​ (#1539)] grant Rock Heart. Rock Heart: For 10s, [​Granite Fury​ (#1539)] evolves into [Stone Fist (#1597)]. When Rock Heart activates, grants 10% Rock Bonus for 10s. Casting [Stone Fist (#1597)] guarantees [Enraged (#1135)].

960.name: Granite
960.description: After casting [Stone Fist (#1597)], for the next 10s, summons 1 [Granite (#1131)] every 2s.

962.name: Granite Fury Pursuit
962.description: Every 50 times damage is taken, the next [Granite Fury (#1539)] deals additional fixed damage equal to 7,000% of Armor. Can trigger at most once every 20s. Every 2% Mastery reduces the required times of damage taken by 1. Every 1% Luck reduces the trigger interval by 1% (up to 50%).

963.name: Rampart Fortitude
963.description: While [Brave Bastion (#1543)] is active, taking DMG doubles [Countercrush (#1125)] DMG.

965.name: Granite Combo
965.description: When [Granite (#1131)] deals DMG, there is a chance, of which equals Luck Chance, to summon an additional [Granite (#1131)].

966.name: Intimidation
966.description: When [Granite (#1131)] hits a target, it reduces all DMG taken by 10% for the next 5s.

967.name: Granite Fury
967.description: Summoning 20 [Granites (#1131)] grants Rock Heart: For 10s, [Granite Fury (#1539)] evolves into [Stone Fist (#1597)].

968.name: Counter Storm
968.description: For 10s after casting [Cracking Echo (#1536)], trigger 1 [Countercrush (#1125)] every 2s.

1100.name: Photon Limit
1100.description: Increases Max Photon Energy by 20, extending the duration of [Photon Reforge (#1138)]. Unaffected when Wildpack Spec is active. If Falconry Spec is activated, the effect becomes: Max Photon Energy -20 but [Photon Reforge (#1138)] state can be entered more quickly.

1102.name: Vulnerable Strike
1102.description: Dealing DMG grants a fixed 30% chance to apply Vulnerability to the enemy. Vulnerability: Increases the DMG you deal to the target by 10% for 5s.

1103.name: Wolf Pact
1103.description: Tames a Wild Wolf to fight alongside you. [Storm Arrow (#1601)] has a 30% fixed chance to trigger Coordinated Attack. Wild Wolf A Wild Wolf fights alongside you. Basic Attack: Sweeps the enemy, dealing Attack DMG equal to 60% ATK (which scales with the Level/Tier of your Basic Attack). Coordinated Attack: Wild Wolf leaps to the enemy and bites, dealing Attack DMG equal to 100% ATK (which scales with the Level/Tier of your Basic Attack).

1104.name: Psychic Surge
1104.description: For every 15 Special Attacks cast, Photon Energy granted by the next cast of [Arrow Rain (#1550)] +100%.

1105.name: Battle Howl
1105.description: While [Wildcall (#1549)] is active, the Wild Wolf is bound to deal Crit DMG on hit.

1106.name: Direwolf's Hunger
1106.description: When the Wild Wolf deals Crit DMG, you and your Beast gain 2% Haste for 10s. This effect stacks up to 5 times. When Haste exceeds 35%, every extra 1% of Haste grants 0.2% ATK.

1107.name: Meditation
1107.description: While in [Photon Reforge (#1138)], Photon Energy drain per second is reduced from 25 to 20, allowing the effect to last longer. Unaffected when Wildpack Spec is active. If Falconry Spec is activated, the effect becomes: Photon Energy regeneration is increased from 2 to 3 points per second, reducing the time required to enter [Photon Reforge (#1138)].

1108.name: Phantom Wolfstrike
1108.description: When Wild Wolf launches a Coordinated Attack, or [Tail Sweep (#1139)], there is a fixed 30% chance to summon a Phantom Direwolf using [Pounce and Bite (#1140)] to attack the current enemy. [Pounce and Bite (#1140)] inflicts [Bleed (#1141)], and if the target is already suffered from [Bleed (#1141)], [Pounce and Bite (#1140)] deals Crit DMG.

1109.name: Direwolf Bite
1109.description: Wild Wolf's Coordinated Attack has a 50% fixed chance to inflict [Bleed (#1141)].

1110.name: Demon Wolf Twin
1110.description: When [Storm Arrow (#1601)] deals DMG in battle, it has a fixed 10% chance to summon a Wild Wolf for 8s. This effect can occur once every 40s.

1111.name: Photon Reforge Lore
1111.description: While [Photon Reforge (#1138)] is active, all of the Wild Wolf's attacks nullify the target's Armor.

1112.name: Twin Arrows
1112.description: [Luminary Bolt (#1546)] additionally causes a Photon Explosion, dealing Attack DMG equal to 1,500% ATK (which scales with the Level/Tier of Ultimate), and also knocks targets airborne and increases the DMG you deal to them by 5% for 10s.

1114.name: Tracer Arrows
1114.description: While [Photon Reforge (#1138)] is active, for each beast on the battlefield, [Storm Arrow (#1601)] fires 1 extra [Lightseeker Arrow (#1142)] (up to 4 arrows).

1116.name: Swift
1116.description: Applies Swift to the Falcon when casting [Lightning Strike (#1143)]. Swiftness: Increases Attack SPD by 10%. This effect lasts 8s and stacks up to 3 times.

1118.name: Falcon Raid
1118.description: For every 3 instances of Crit DMG dealt by Special Attacks, the Falcon instantly launches [Lightning Strike (#1143)].

1119.name: Meteor
1119.description: When the Falcon strikes, grants you a fixed 30% chance to gain 1 stack of Weak Point Aim. Using [Quadraflare (#1557)] leaves behind a Radiance Rift midair. Radiance Rift fires [Photon Arrows (#1188)] equal to the current number of Weak Point Aim stacks.

1120.name: Piercing Shot
1120.description: Increases the Crit of [Double Arrow (#1547)] and [Quadraflare (#1557)] by 7%.

1121.name: Falcon's Heart
1121.description: The Falcon ignores 30% of the target's Armor.

1122.name: Lightfall
1122.description: Each 1% critical rate increases Crit DMG by 0.5%. When [Double Arrow (#1547)] or [Quadraflare (#1557)] deals Crit DMG, 2 Photon Energy is restored.

1123.name: Focused Shot
1123.description: Every target hit grants 1% Light DMG bonus. The bonus lasts 3s and can layerup to 4 times.

1124.name: Valiant Heart
1124.description: Companions deal 15% more DMG to Elites or stronger enemies.

1125.name: Overcharge
1125.description: When Basic Attacks deal DMG, there is a 5% fixed chance to instantly grant Special Attack 1 charge, up to the maximum charge limit.

1126.name: Wildpack Spec
1126.description: Further enhances [Storm Arrow (#1601)] and the Wild Wolf's power. [Storm Arrow (#1601)] always deals 200% Crit DMG on critical hits. While [Photon Reforge (#1138)] is active, the chance for the Wild Wolf to trigger Coordinated Attack is increased to 100%. The Wild Wolf becomes empowered, and Haste allows both you and the wolf to attack more frequently.

1127.name: Arrow Barrage
1127.description: Basic Attacks have a fixed 20% chance to fire one arrow at each of up to 3 enemies near the target.

1128.name: Sundering Arrow
1128.description: Basic Attacks have a fixed 15% chance to trigger [Split Arrow (#1151)], once per second.

1129.name: Falconry Spec
1129.description: Replaces Special Attack with [Double Arrow (#1547)] and enhances the ability to use this skill. Regenerates 2 Photon Energy per second. Each 1% Haste grants 1% CD decrease to [Double Arrow (#1547)]. You can tame a Falcon to assist you in battle. Falcon always follows the caster. When the caster deals DMG with Class Skills, the Falcon has a fixed 23% chance to swiftly strike the target (guaranteed on Crit), dealing Attack DMG equal to 150% ATK to the enemy (which scales with the Level/Tier of Basic Attack). Additionally, when the strike count of the Falcon exceeds 5, the next strike of the Falcon combines all excess strikes and DMG. The Falcon responds to the caster's attacks. Haste and Crit increase its strike frequency, and after learning Lightning Strike, the Falcon deals significantly more DMG.

1130.name: Wolf Dancer
1130.description: After you use [Arrow Rain (#1550)], the Wild Wolf continuously performs [Tail Sweep (#1139)] until the [Arrow Rain (#1550)] ends. Wild Wolf's [Tail Sweep (#1139)] is bound to deal Crit DMG and to inflict [Bleed (#1141)].

1131.name: Explosive Arrow
1131.description: When a Basic Attack or Special Attack deals DMG, it has a fixed 10% chance to fire an [Explosive Arrow (#1144)], once every 3s.

1132.name: Rapid Shot
1132.description: Every 5% Haste provides an additional 1% attack speed.

1134.name: Dexterity
1134.description: When Agility reaches 500 points, attack speed +5%.

1136.name: Wolf Sharp Strike
1136.description: In the state of [Photon Reforge (#1138)], Wolf Crit DMG +50%.

1137.name: Beast Tidal Power
1137.description: Increases Light Bonus by 3%. For 5s after casting [Torrent Volley (#1580)] or its enhanced form [Lumi Torrent (#1602)], increases Light Bonus by 10%.

1138.name: Arrow Rain Acceleration
1138.description: Each time you summon 1 Wolf or Phantom Wolf, the remaining CD of [Arrow Rain (#1550)] -0.5s.

1139.name: Life Hunt
1139.description: For each additional [Bleed (#1141)] effect on the target, Wolf deals +3% damage to it.

1140.name: Wolf Fang Pact
1140.description: Wild Wolf's Coordinated Attack or Tail Sweep deals damage (triggers only once even when hitting multiple targets) and reduces the remaining CD of [Storm Arrow (#1601)] by 1s.

1141.name: Light and Shadow Drain
1141.description: [Lightseeker Arrow (#1142)] has a fixed 50% chance to apply [Bleed (#1141)] to the target.

1142.name: Wolf Evolution
1142.description: Wild Wolf evolves into its Adult Form, increases DMG by 30%, DMG Range by 50%.

1143.name: Legendary Beast
1143.description: Casting [Wildcall (#1549)] summons a Legendary Companion based on current Photon Energy: If Photon Energy is below 50%, summons [Legendary Eagle (#1146)]. If Photon Energy reaches 50% or more, summons [Legendary Boar (#1147)]. [Wildcall (#1549)] now holds up to 2 charges.

1144.name: Lumi Torrent
1144.description: While in [Photon Reforge (#1138)] state, [Torrent Volley (#1580)] continuously charges. After 30s of charging, [Torrent Volley (#1580)] evolves into [Lumi Torrent (#1602)]. Upon casting [Lumi Torrent (#1602)], immediately gain full Photon Energy.

1145.name: Wild Call CD
1145.description: For each [Lightseeker Arrow (#1142)] fired, reduces the remaining CD of [Wildcall (#1549)] by 0.4s (when Haste exceeds 30%, each extra 1% Haste reduces an additional 0.005s, up to 0.8s).

1147.name: Light Chasing Sharp
1147.description: While [Photon Reforge (#1138)] is active, reduces [Storm Arrow (#1601)] CD by 50%.

1148.name: Arrow of Light
1148.description: [Arrow Rain (#1550)] and [Lightseeker Arrow (#1142)] are bound to deal Crit DMG.

1150.name: Wolf's Bite
1150.description: Wild Wolf deals additionally 30% DMG to targets with current HP less than or equal to 35%.

1151.name: Stomp
1151.description: Casting [Wildcall (#1549)] again within 10s of its initial cast commands all beasts on the field to immediately cast [Stomp (#1145)].

1152.name: Steel Beak
1152.description: When the caster and the Falcon deal Crit DMG, inflicts 1 stack of [Steel Beak (#1148)] to the target. Every 10 stacks of [Steel Beak (#1148)] trigger [Lightning Strike (#1143)], up to once every 3s.

1153.name: Phantom Falcon
1153.description: Triggering Implosion 5 times summons a [Phantom Falcon (#1150)] to charge at the target. For each additional target hit by the [Phantom Falcon (#1150)], its DMG increases by 20%, up to 200%.

1154.name: Focused Concentration
1154.description: Throughout the duration of [Focus (#1555)], gains 0.5% Crit and 1% Crit DMG every 0.5s, stacking up to 15 times.

1155.name: Dual Arrow Mastery
1155.description: When a Special Attack deals Crit DMG, reduces the remaining CD of [Blast Shot (#1548)] and [Powerdraw (#1582)] by 1 second.

1156.name: Sharp Double Arrow I
1156.description: Increases the Crit DMG of [Double Arrow (#1547)] and [Quadraflare (#1557)] by 15%.

1157.name: Light Energy Stasis
1157.description: When [Radiance Barrage (#1581)] hits a target, it applies Light Energy Stasis to them. Light Energy Stasis: movement speed -30%. Being hit by [Powerdraw (#1582)] is bound to deal Crit DMG. Lasts for 5s.

1158.name: Falcon Break
1158.description: The Falcon ignores 20% of the target's Armor, and 40% when dealing Crit DMG.

1159.name: Eagle Eye
1159.description: When Photon Energy is above 50%, casting [Radiance Barrage (#1581)] counts as [Photon Reforge (#1138)].

1160.name: Celestial Eagle
1160.description: While [Focus (#1555)] is active, [Radiance Barrage (#1581)] summons 1 [Celestial Eagle (#1149)] at the target's location. Now, each 1% of Haste increases the CD Boost of Focus by 1%.

1161.name: Radiant Charge
1161.description: When an arrow fired from Radiance Rift deals DMG for 1 time, increases the DMG of the next [Blast Shot (#1548)] by 20%, up to a maximum of 100%.

1162.name: Light Prism
1162.description: When [Lightning Strike (#1143)] hits a target, it triggers Light Prism. Light Prism: Deals area damage equal to 100% ATK to up to 5 surrounding enemy targets, and additionally applies 3 stacks of [Steel Beak (#1148)].

1164.name: Energy Gathering Power
1164.description: [Powerdraw (#1582)] CD -50%. When Photon Energy is above 50%, casting [Powerdraw (#1582)] counts as [Photon Reforge (#1138)].

1165.name: Steel Beak Strike
1165.description: When [Powerdraw (#1582)] hits a target, it applies 2 stacks of [Steel Beak (#1148)]. If it deals Crit DMG, it applies 5 stacks of [Steel Beak (#1148)].

1166.name: Steel Beak Gathering
1166.description: When [Celestial Eagle (#1149)] hits a target, it prevents the target's [Steel Beak (#1148)] from naturally decaying.

1167.name: Chain Explosion
1167.description: [Blast Shot (#1548)] Upon detonation, inflicts 10 stacks of [Steel Beak (#1148)] on all targets hit.

1200.name: Lightforged Body
1200.description: Every 1 Holy Sigil consumed grants a [Radiant Shield (#1172)] equal to 45% ATK (depending on Adventurer Level, up to 90%).

1201.name: Condemn
1201.description: When casting a skill that consumes Photon Energy, there is a 30% fixed chance for Basic Attacks to evolve into [Condemn (#1598)].

1202.name: Blessing of Holy Sigil
1202.description: When using a Skill that consumes Holy Sigils, 20% chance for your next Holy Sigil-consuming skill to consume no Holy Sigils. The effect lasts for 8s or until a Holy Sigil-consuming skill is cast.

1203.name: Ring of Judgment
1203.description: Casting [Judgment (#1564)] generates a [Divine Circle (#1560)], with a CD of 30s. Each Holy Sigil consumed reduces the remaining CD by 1s.

1204.name: Lightforge Continuum
1204.description: For every 20 Photon Energy consumed, gains [Radiant Shield (#1172)] equal to 45% ATK (this ratio is affected by Adventurer Level, up to 90%).

1205.name: Haste Sigil
1205.description: Each 1% Haste increases the recovery speed of Holy Sigil by 1%. Recovery time = Initial recovery time / (1 + recovery speed bonus).

1207.name: Light of Condemn
1207.description: While inside a [Divine Circle (#1560)], your [Condemn (#1598)] is enhanced, thrusting a blade of light forward and dealing double DMG.

1208.name: Recovery Spec
1208.description: Further enhances your ability to use [Valor Bash (#1561)]. [Valor Bash (#1561)] is accompanied by [Radiant Impact (#1174)]. Try to maintain the Armor bonus from Valor Bash, and trigger Inferno Reckon through high Crits to gain more Photon Energy. Sufficient Photon Energy means continuous self-healing under the blessing of Judgment and Scorching Judgment.

1209.name: Oracle
1209.description: When a skill that consumes Holy Sigil critically hits, gain an additional 30% Photon Energy. Crit DMG of skills that consume Photon Energy +30%.

1210.name: Judgment Revelation
1210.description: When [Divine Strike (#1177)] Crits, there's a 50% fixed chance to automatically cast [Judgment (#1564)] on the target (this [Judgment (#1564)] cannot trigger [Divine Strike (#1177)]).

1211.name: Divine Circle Defender
1211.description: While within the [Divine Circle (#1560)], the Armor effect provided by [Valor Bash (#1561)] +30%.

1212.name: Radiant Guard
1212.description: Casting [Shield Toss (#1562)] immediately grants a [Radiant Shield (#1172)] equal to 55% Armor (affected by Versatility and Element bonuses). The charge count of [Shield Toss (#1562)] +1.

1213.name: Aegis Ward's Anthem
1213.description: For every 2 Holy Sigils consumed, the remaining CD of [Aegis Ward (#1565)] -1 second.

1214.name: Fearless Shield
1214.description: Each time [Shield Toss (#1562)] deals DMG, gain a [Radiant Shield (#1172)] equal to 13.75% Armor (affected by Versatility and Element bonuses).

1215.name: Aegis Ward's Retribution
1215.description: During [Aegis Ward (#1565)], [Block (#1170)] chance is increased to 1.5 times. When attacked, reduces [Aegis Ward (#1565)]'s remaining CD by 0.5s. This effect can only trigger once per second.

1216.name: Lightforged Greatsword
1216.description: After every 10 casts of [Judgment (#1564)], the next [Judgment (#1564)] is enhanced into Scorching Judgment. Scorching Judgment: Summon a holy greatsword to descend upon the target area for 5s, healing yourself (Healing equal to that of [Judgment (#1564)]) while dealing damage over time to nearby enemies and inflicting Scorch, totally dealing Attack DMG equal to 600% ATK (scales with [Judgment (#1564)] level/rank). Scorch: Reduces damage taken from the target by 3% for 10s. Stacks up to 10 times. Grants 3 stacks of Scorch on Crit.

1217.name: Holy Barrier
1217.description: Using Ultimate Skill creates a Holy Barrier, shielding nearby allies from DMG. The Holy Barrier lasts for 15s or until it absorbs Total DMG equal to 150% Max HP +3000% Armor.

1218.name: Shield Spec
1218.description: Replaces Special Attack with [Vanguard Strike (#1566)] and enhances its power. Each additional enemy hit by [Vanguard Strike (#1566)] grants 2 extra Photon Energy, up to 10. Successfully Block prevents losing the stacks of Lightforged Barrier. Lightforged Barrier: Each stack increases Max HP by 2%, up to 10 stacks, with each instance of DMG removing 1 stack. It lasts 25s or until all stacks are consumed. gaining stacks resets the duration. Managing Lightforged Barrier is crucial for sustaining high HP and triggering self-healing and DMG Reduction effects from Judgment, Zeal Crusade, and Radiance.

1220.name: Ascension of the Lightforged Barrier
1220.description: Photon Energy cap +20. When you have at least 5 stacks of [Lightforged Barrier (#1175)], [Judgment (#1564)] consumes 5 less Photon Energy.

1221.name: Divine Circle Chant
1221.description: The recovery rate of Holy Sigils from Haste +100%.

1222.name: Holy Strike
1222.description: Each time 1 stack of [Lightforged Barrier (#1175)] is consumed or deducted, 10% chance to obtain 1 Holy Sigil.

1223.name: Holy Radiance
1223.description: When [Sacred Blade (#1559)] hits an enemy target, it applies a [Holy Mark (#1199)] to the target. [Vanguard Strike (#1566)] can spread this [Holy Mark (#1199)] to hit enemy targets.

1224.name: Determination Slash
1224.description: When [Lightforged Barrier (#1175)] has 5 or fewer stacks, taking DMG no longer reduces its stacks. When [Lightforged Barrier (#1175)] has more than 5 stacks, taking DMG has a 50% fixed chance not to reduce its stacks.

1225.name: Lightforged Drive
1225.description: When casting [Radiance (#1568)], it automatically releases [Judgment (#1564)] to up to 5 nearby enemy targets.

1226.name: Ruthless Rewind
1226.description: During [Zeal Crusade (#1567)], each Holy Sigil consumed grants [Zeal Crusade (#1567)] 1 stack of charge. When the charge reaches 3 stacks, [Zeal Crusade (#1567)] bursts outward, dealing DMG equal to 6% max HP.

1227.name: Divine Circle Resonance
1227.description: For each enemy inside [Divine Circle (#1560)], increases [Divine Circle (#1560)] DMG by 25% and [Divine Circle (#1560)] Healing by 5% (caps at 10 enemies).

1228.name: Judgment Pursuit
1228.description: Every 50 times damage is taken, the next [Judgment (#1564)] deals additional fixed damage equal to 200% Max HP. Can trigger at most once every 20s. Every 2% of Mastery reduces the required times of damage taken by 1. Every 1% of Haste reduces the trigger interval by 1% (up to 50%).

1229.name: Divine Circle Blessing
1229.description: While within the [Divine Circle (#1560)], your Healing Received +10%.

1230.name: Lightforged Balance
1230.description: When your HP percentage is higher than your target's, DMG taken from that target -5%. When your HP percentage is lower than your target's, [Judgment (#1564)] deals 50% more DMG.

1231.name: Lightforged Fortitude
1231.description: Throughout the duration of [Radiant Shield (#1172)], [Block (#1170)] chance +10%.

1232.name: Energy Guard
1232.description: After casting an Ultimate, all allies' Max HP is increased by 10% for 10s (this effect does not stack).

1233.name: Life Enhancement
1233.description: When Strength reaches 500 points, Max HP +12%.

1234.name: Condemn Time Limit
1234.description: When [Condemn (#1598)] deals damage, it immediately cools down 1 Holy Sigil (prioritizing the Holy Sigil with the longest remaining CD).

1235.name: Sword Dance
1235.description: When a Expertise Skill critically heals, gain a 15% healing bonus.

1236.name: Shield Impact
1236.description: Hold [Valor Bash (#1561)] to charge, then dash forward a short distance.

1237.name: Reckon Shield
1237.description: Each time [Inferno Reckon (#1600)] or [Reckoning (#1563)] deals Crit DMG to 1 enemy target, [Block (#1170)] chance +5%, lasting for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.

1238.name: Holy Light Time Limit
1238.description: During [Aegis Ward (#1565)], when an Expertise Skill deals Crit DMG, there's a 50% fixed chance to instantly reset 1 Holy Sigil CD (prioritizing Holy Sigil with the longest remaining CD). This effect triggers only once when multiple targets are hit.

1239.name: Holy Summon
1239.description: When [Shield Toss (#1562)] or [Judgment (#1564)] deals DMG, 10% chance to trigger [Divine Strike (#1177)]. If Crit DMG is dealt, the chance increases to 50%.

1240.name: Light Chain
1240.description: While [Aegis Ward (#1565)] is active, the chance of [Divine Strike (#1177)] is doubled. Every 3 times [Divine Strike (#1177)] is triggered, the duration of [Aegis Ward (#1565)] is extended by 1 second.

1241.name: Reckon Blaze
1241.description: When [Valor Bash (#1561)] deals Crit DMG, gain Blazing. Casting [Aegis Ward (#1565)] guarantees Blazing. Scorching Heat: For the next 10s, [Reckoning (#1563)] evolves into [Inferno Reckon (#1600)].

1242.name: Holy Heal
1242.description: While having [Radiant Shield (#1172)], gains 12% healing bonus.

1243.name: Light Protection
1243.description: While having [Radiant Shield (#1172)], gain 5% Light bonus.

1244.name: Ultimate Guard
1244.description: For 10s after casting [Shield Toss (#1562)], increases [Block Chance (#1170)] by 15%.

1245.name: Shield Guard
1245.description: [Valor Bash (#1561)] heals for 120% ATK when it deals DMG, and increases DMG dealt by 8% for 8s.

1247.name: Ultimate Strike
1247.description: When [Divine Strike (#1177)] deals DMG, increases Strength by 2% for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.

1248.name: Magic Guard
1248.description: While [Aegis Ward (#1565)] is active, each 1% Mastery grants 0.5% MATK Reduction, up to 30%.

1251.name: Adversity Enhancement
1251.description: Special Attack and damaging Expertise are enhanced based on missing HP. For every 1% HP lost, increases their DMG by 1%.

1252.name: Wide Raid
1252.description: Increases [Zeal Crusade (#1567)] range by 100%. While [Zeal Crusade (#1567)] is active, the effect of Bold Fearless is doubled.

1253.name: Bold Fearless
1253.description: When [Sacred Blade (#1559)] or [Judgment (#1564)] deals DMG, there is a fixed 25% chance to cause [Vanguard Strike (#1566)] to evolve into [Vanguard Hunt (#1176)]. [Vanguard Hunt (#1176)]: Deals Attack DMG equal to 240% ATK to the target, restores 2% of your max HP, and gains Bold Fearless. Bold Fearless: Increases Haste by 3% for 10s, stacking up to 10 times.

1254.name: Radiant Core
1254.description: [Vanguard Hunt (#1176)] can grant [Radiant Core (#1198)]. Gaining [Radiant Core (#1198)] again reduces its burst time by 2s.

1255.name: Conquest Pursuit
1255.description: While [Zeal Crusade (#1567)] is active, [Vanguard Strike (#1566)] evolves into [Vanguard Hunt (#1176)].

1256.name: Decisive Blade
1256.description: After [Radiant Core (#1198)] explosion, [Sacred Blade (#1559)] DMG +100% for 20s. Holds up to 3 charges, casting [Sacred Blade (#1559)] consumes one charge.

1257.name: Zeal Haste
1257.description: For every 15 points of Photon Energy consumed, the remaining CD of [Zeal Crusade (#1567)] -1 second.

1258.name: Holy Sigil Enhancement
1258.description: When [Judgment (#1564)] deals DMG, the target takes double DMG from [Holy Mark (#1199)] for the next 5s.

1259.name: Divine Guard
1259.description: When in the [Divine Circle (#1560)], reduces all DMG taken by 10%. For each enemy within 10m, ATK Reduction increases by 1.5% (up to 9%), and MATK Reduction increases by 0.75% (up to 4.5%).

1260.name: Judgment Improvement
1260.description: For each 1 stack of [Lightforged Barrier (#1175)] you possess, [Judgment (#1564)] gains 2% healing bonus. When [Lightforged Barrier (#1175)]≥5 stacks, DMG Reduction +8%.

1261.name: Sigil Pursuit
1261.description: DMG dealt by [Vanguard Hunt (#1176)] and [Sacred Blade (#1559)] to targets with [Holy Mark (#1199)] increases by 20%.

1262.name: Overflow Healwall
1262.description: When your accumulated overhealing reaches 10% of your Max HP, gains 1 stack of [Lightforged Barrier (#1175)].

1263.name: Light Healing
1263.description: While having [Radiant Shield (#1172)], gains 12% healing bonus.

1264.name: Light Protection
1264.description: While having [Radiant shield (#1172)], gain 5% Light bonus.

1265.name: Resolved to Return
1265.description: Each time 1 stack of [Lightforged Barrier (#1175)] is consumed or deducted, reduces the remaining CD of [Radiance (#1568)] by 1 second.

1266.name: Halo
1266.description: [Divine Circle (#1560)] now has a halo effect, [stunning (#3005)] enemy targets for 3s the first time it deals DMG.

1267.name: Judgment Pursuit
1267.description: Every 50 times damage is taken, the next [Judgment (#1564)] deals additional fixed damage equal to 5000% of Armor. Can trigger at most once every 20s. Every 2% Mastery reduces the required times of damage taken by 1. Every 1% Crit reduces the trigger interval by 1% (up to 50%).

1300.name: Passion Surge
1300.description: When [Melody (#1133)] is active, there is a 15% fixed chance per second to gain Passion Surge. Passion Surge: Special Attack costs zero Performance Passion for 10s. Removed after Special Attack is cast.

1302.name: Heat Surge
1302.description: When [Melody (#1133)] is activated, the trigger chance for Passion Surge +an extra 3% every 1 second (up to 30%). Passion Surge: Special Attack costs zero Performance Passion for 10s. Removed after Special Attack is cast.

1303.name: Intellect Conversion
1303.description: Every 10 points of Intellect provides 1 point of MATK.

1304.name: Arcane Ascension
1304.description: Special Attack costs 1 less Performance Passion.

1305.name: Melody: Heat Core
1305.description: [Melody (#1133)] heals ally targets below 50% HP with 100% bonus effect.

1306.name: Flame Pursuit
1306.description: After using 3 Special Attacks, the next Basic Attack hit triggers [Flame Pillar Blast (#1190)].

1307.name: Flame Pursuit II
1307.description: [Flame Pillar Blast (#1190)] becomes a two-hit combo.

1308.name: Dissonance Spec
1308.description: While in [Rhapsody of Flame (#1603)], increases all Luck Chance acquired by any means by 50% and increases DMG Reduction by 25%. Healing of Stillness: If you deal no DMG to enemies for 5s, each hit of your Basic Attack will heal up to 10 allies (party members prioritized), with the full 4-hit combo restoring 15.75% of their max HP in total. After casting an Ultimate, Basic Attacks immediately start healing, and [Fierce Strike (#1615)] can trigger the 4th hit healing effect, but this is disabled upon dealing DMG to enemies. Maintaining Heroic Melody and Rhapsody of Flame is crucial. Heroic Melody enhances healing while consecutive Fierce Strikes accelerate Harmonic Anthem casting frequency.

1309.name: Lucky Soundwave
1309.description: Gains 1 Soundwave Energy whenever Expertise Skills or [Amplified Beat (#1604)] trigger a Lucky Strike.

1310.name: Trio Rhapsody
1310.description: [Rhapsody of Flame (#1603)] always appears in its most powerful form. While in [Rhapsody of Flame (#1603)], ATK increases by Haste % x 0.6.

1311.name: Severed Chapter
1311.description: Increases Resilience Break Efficiency of self and Allies within 30 meters by 10%. This effect cannot stack. After activating [Heroic Melody (#1614)], you and Allies within 30 meters have an resilience break efficiency +30% and deal 15% more DMG to Resilience Broken targets. This effect cannot stack.

1312.name: Sound Blaze
1312.description: Gain 1 Soundwave Energy each time you deal DMG equal to 10 times ATK. Soundwave Energy stores up to 50. Skills consuming Performance Passion trigger [Scorching Impact (#1191)] when dealing DMG, consuming all Soundwave Energy. Each 1 Soundwave Energy increases [Scorching Impact (#1191)] DMG by 16%.

1313.name: Healing Note
1313.description: Basic Attack deals an extra instance of DMG. For every 5 Soundwave Energy obtained, creates a [Note (#1192)] for the ally with the lowest HP.

1314.name: Blazing Heal
1314.description: Stores excess Healing (up to 500% of Max HP). After activating [Heroic Melody (#1614)], consumes stored Healing to recover allies' HP every 1 second, up to 15% of Max HP per second.

1315.name: Concerto
1315.description: During [Rhapsody of Flame (#1603)], [Amplified Beat (#1604)] gains 1 additional attack. [Amplified Beat (#1604)]'s DMG -20%.

1316.name: Restart
1316.description: When [Harmonic Anthem (#1605)] or [Fierce Strike (#1615)] triggers a Lucky Strike, limited to a single activation when striking multiple targets, immediately resets [Rhapsody of Flame (#1603)]'s CD and allows [Rhapsody of Flame (#1603)] not to consume Performance Passion for 10s, this effect is nullified upon casting [Rhapsody of Flame (#1603)].

1317.name: Concerto Spec
1317.description: Replaces Special Attack with [Healing Beat (#1609)]. While [Healing Melody (#1606)] is active, reduces the remaining CD of [Fivefold Crescendo (#1607)] and [Passion Burst (#1608)] by 1 second per second. Precisely placing the speaker ensures it echoes your Expertise whenever they are cast.

1318.name: Brilliant Charge
1318.description: When [Healing Beat (#1609)] or [Passion Burst (#1608)] applies Crit Healing or deals Crit DMG (triggers only once when hitting multiple targets), gains 1 Performance Passion.

1319.name: Double Recovery Note
1319.description: [Healing Beat (#1609)] provides an additional equal Healing to targets under the influence of [Healing Melody (#1606)].

1322.name: Critical Encore
1322.description: Every 1% Crit Rate grants 1% trigger chance for [Encore Strings (#1193)].

1323.name: Passion Fury
1323.description: For each 10 Performance Passion consumed, enhances [Passion Burst (#1608)] to [Passion Fury (#1617)] for 10s.

1324.name: Stat Resonance
1324.description: While [Healing Melody (#1606)] is active, grants allies appropriate buffs (Strength, Intellect, Agility) equal to 8% of Intellect. (Buffs from different Beat Performers cannot stack. Only one with the highest value applies.)

1325.name: Stat Resonance Crit
1325.description: For 10s after using [Passion Burst (#1608)] or its enhanced form ([Passion Fury), doubles the buffs that Healing Melody (#1617)] provides to allies. While channeling [Passion Fury (#1617)], DMG Reduction +10%. The duration of the doubled stat buffs is refreshed and extended by 0.4s for every 0.2s channeled.

1326.name: Fire Day
1326.description: Increases Fire Bonus by 8% when attacking Elite or higher targets.

1327.name: Critical Acclaim
1327.description: During [Center Stage (#1610)], triggering [Encore Strings (#1193)] has a 30% fixed chance to grant Passion Surge. Passion Surge: Special Attack costs zero Performance Passion for 10s. Removed after Special Attack is cast.

1328.name: Rhythm Spirit
1328.description: Defeating an enemy has a fixed 50% chance to grant you 1 Performance Passion.

1329.name: Infinite Rhapsody
1329.description: Replace Ultimate [Rock the Stage (#1579)] with [Infinite Rhapsody (#1612)].

1330.name: Concert Circuit
1330.description: Replace Ultimate [Rock the Stage (#1579)] with [Concert Circuit (#1613)].

1331.name: Encore Chain
1331.description: When [Encore Strings (#1193)] triggers, it activates a second time on the same target.

1332.name: Heat Boost
1332.description: When Intellect reaches 500, the Performance Energy cap +20%.

1333.name: Variation
1333.description: Increases Max HP by 20% and activates Dissonance Spec with its original effect intact. If Concerto Spec is activated, its effect is adjusted to replace Basic Attack with [Resonant Strings (#1618)].

1334.name: Melody Chord
1334.description: [Melody (#1133)] Healing +20%. Each 1% Haste increases the REG SPD of Performance Passion by 1%.

1336.name: Indomitable Chord
1336.description: While [Heroic Melody (#1614)] is active, grants [Super Armor (#1102)], increases DMG Reduction by 25%, and boosts Movement Speed by 10%. [While Heroic Melody (#1614)] is active, grants Tenacity Chord. Each stack of Tenacity Chord additionally increases Max HP by 0.5% (up to 2.5% Max HP) for 5s (duration cannot be refreshed once 5 stacks are reached).

1337.name: Swing Reflux
