1337.description: Hitting a target with [Fierce Strike (#1615)] recovers 5 Performance Energy. Each additional target hit provides 1 extra Performance Energy, up to 10 total.

1338.name: Luck Multiplier
1338.description: Every 1% Luck grants 0.5% Lucky Strike DMG Multiplier. After activating [Heroic Melody (#1614)], doubles its conversion efficiency.

1339.name: Resonant Counterpoint
1339.description: When a [Note (#1192)] forms, there's a 50% fixed chance to create an extra [Note (#1192)] for a different target.

1340.name: Sonic Cure
1340.description: When Expertise deal DMG (only triggers once when hitting multiple targets), additionally heal targets with [Note (#1192)].

1341.name: Sonic Therapy
1341.description: Converted healing from DMG +20% for targets affected by [Note (#1192)].

1342.name: Flame's Rampage
1342.description: When [Heroic Melody (#1614)] is active, [Rhapsody of Flame (#1603)] will erupt, dealing Magic DMG equal to 350% ATK every 3s to targets it touches (DMG interval affected by Haste). This DMG can trigger Lucky Strike. While in [Rhapsody of Flame (#1603)], each hit of [Harmonic Anthem (#1605)] also heals 1 ally with the lowest HP for 30% of the DMG dealt (this value scales proportionally when hitting multiple targets).

1343.name: Flame Note
1343.description: When you use an Expertise Skill, [Rhapsody of Flame (#1603)] will erupt with Rhythm, dealing Magic DMG equal to 700% of ATK and granting [Note (#1192)] to allies it touches.

1344.name: Finale Command
1344.description: Within 10s of casting [Encore (#1616)], each use of [Rhapsody of Flame (#1603)] caused targets affected by [Encore (#1616)] to trigger [Encore Strings (#1193)].

1345.name: Encore Persistence
1345.description: Permanently benefits from [Encore (#1616)] effect. For every 5 triggers of [Encore Strings (#1193)], the next [Amplified Beat (#1604)] and [Harmonic Anthem (#1605)] deal 50% more DMG.

1346.name: Encore Luck Boost
1346.description: Every 1% Luck Chance grants 1% trigger chance for [Encore Strings (#1193)].

1347.name: Encore Sharp Strike
1347.description: Triggering [Encore Strings (#1193)] to deal DMG or healing grants 2 Performance Energy. If the [Encore Strings (#1193)] triggers Lucky Strike, grants 3 additional Performance Energy.

1348.name: Absolute Center Stage
1348.description: After you use [Center Stage (#1610)], the number of enhanced skills increases from 1 to 2.

1349.name: Center Stage: Mad Tune
1349.description: Each Performance Passion consumed reduces the CD of [Center Stage (#1610)] by 1 second.

1350.name: Tower Multiwave
1350.description: Casting [Center Stage (#1610)] immediately extends [Heroic Melody (#1614)] by 5s.

1351.name: Soundwave Overclock
1351.description: Upon casting [Center Stage (#1610)], grants 15 Soundwave Energy, and doubles all the Soundwave Energy gained in the next 10s.

1352.name: Crit Charge Rhythm
1352.description: [Fivefold Crescendo (#1607)] deals Crit DMG or healing (only triggers once for multiple targets), grants 2 Performance Energy. When [Healing Melody (#1606)] lands a Crit Hit, grants 1 Performance Energy(only triggers once for multiple targets).

1353.name: Tower Flame Blast
1353.description: The speaker releases a [Flame Shock (#1197)] every 5s.

1354.name: Multi-Target Heat Amp
1354.description: [Passion Burst (#1608)] and its enhanced version ([Passion Fury (#1617)]) deal 5% more DMG per additional target hit, up to 25%.

1355.name: Heated Tower Flame Blast
1355.description: When [Passion Burst (#1608)] and its enhanced version ([Passion Fury (#1617)]) hit the speaker, it immediately releases a [Flame Shock (#1197)].

1356.name: Sonic Verdict
1356.description: While [Healing Melody (#1606)] is active, [Fivefold Crescendo (#1607)] also deals DMG, with its total DMG scaling equal to its healing multiplier. [While Healing Melody (#1606)] is active, reduces the caster's DMG taken by (10% + Haste % x 0.4) (max -30%).

1357.name: Harmonic Amplifier
1357.description: Increases the DMG dealt and healing of skills triggered by the speaker by 30%.

1358.name: Crescendo Healing Chord
1358.description: [Healing Melody (#1606)] gains 7% Healing Strength for every second it remains active, stacking up to 5 times. [Healing Melody (#1606)] additionally restores a fixed amount equal to 0.3% of the target's Max HP when healing.

1359.name: Crit Scale
1359.description: Increases Crit Rate by 10% against enemies above 50% HP. Increases Crit Rate by 10% against enemies below 50% HP.

1360.name: Symphonic Aria
1360.description: Enhances Healing by 10% for targets affected by [Healing Melody (#1606)].

1361.name: Vitality Unleash
1361.description: 7% of DMG dealt and 15% of healing done is stored as Rhythm. Within 10s after you cast [Center Stage (#1610)], the use of Expertise and [Healing Beat (#1609)] consumes Rhythm to grant up to 40% bonus healing. The cap for Rhythm storage is 30 times MATK.

1362.name: Encore Chain
1362.description: Within 10s after you cast [Encore (#1616)], each use of Expertise Skill triggers [Encore Strings (#1193)] for targets affected by [Encore (#1616)].

1363.name: Tower Resonance
1363.description: Permanently benefits from [Encore (#1616)] effect. Each trigger of [Encore Strings (#1193)] reduces the remaining CD of Expertise by 1 second.

1364.name: Stat Resonance Overload
1364.description: For 15s after actively casting [Encore (#1616)], the stat bonuses provided by [Healing Melody (#1606)] are +100%.

1365.name: Center Stage: Concerto
1365.description: The charges of [Center Stage (#1610)] increase by 1.

1366.name: Absolute Center Stage
1366.description: After you use [Center Stage (#1610)], the number of enhanced skills increases from 1 to 2.

1367.name: Spiral Flame
1367.description: After casting [Center Stage (#1610)], summon a wave of [Sonic Surge (#1173)].

3901.name: Inferno Ogre
3901.description: Transforms into Boss: Inferno Ogre to unleash a forward fiery breath that deals Attack DMG and [interrupts (#3000)] affected targets. Concurrently, applies Healing to you, and 100% excess healing is converted into a Shield lasting 20s. The transformed form reduces DMG taken by 50%.

3902.name: Tempest Ogre
3902.description: Summons Boss: Tempest Ogre and channels the power of thunder to generate a vortex, continuously pulling in enemies near the target and dealing AoE Magic DMG when the duration ends.

3903.name: Brigand Leader
3903.description: Transforms into Boss: Brigand Leader and summons a blazing giant axe, increasing the party's ATK within range for a period and granting yourself additional ATK boost. (This effect cannot stack and only one can be active at a time.)

3904.name: Muku Warrior
3904.description: Summons Elite: Muku Warrior to leap forward and deliver a powerful strike, dealing AoE Attack DMG. This attack is guaranteed to Crit. Upon the skill cast, your Crit and Crit DMG are increased for a period.

3905.name: Boarrier Tyrant
3905.description: Summons Elite: Boarrier Tyrant to charge forward with tusks for 3s. Deals Attack DMG and knocks enemies airborne during the charge. Boarrier tusks tear through flesh, inflicting 100% [Wound (#3004)] on enemies hit for 15s. Upon the skill cast, the DMG dealt and healing of your Special Attack are increased for a period.

3906.name: Frost Ogre
3906.description: Summons Boss: Frost Ogre to execute a spinning attack with an ice hammer, resulting in Attack DMG and [freezing (#1171)] all targets on hit. Upon the skill cast, your Resilience Break Bonus is increased for a period.

3907.name: Inferno Goblin Mage
3907.description: Transforms into Elite: Inferno Goblin Mage and summons meteors from the sky, dealing Magic DMG and [interrupting (#3000)] the target's actions. Upon the skill cast, your Intellect is increased for a period.

3908.name: Muku King
3908.description: Summons Boss: Muku King to channel Forest Energy, healing up to 10 allies over time and dispelling [debuffs (#3021)]. Upon the skill cast, your healing received is increased for a period.

3910.name: ​Void Ogre
3910.description: Summons Elite: Void Ogre, roars in place, and fires 6 whirlwind-like Void Projectiles at the target, dealing Attack DMG. Inflicts Void Corruption Decay on the target for 10s, dealing Magic DMG per second, up to 5 stacks. 100% of the DMG dealt over time is converted into your HP.

3911.name: Tatta
3911.description: Summons Tatta to grant Battle Will to the entire team, preventing all allies from being defeated and ensuring their HP does not fall below a certain threshold for a period of time. Exhausted: Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s (Exhausted effects are enhanced in party dungeons of Nightmare mode).

3913.name: Shadow Captain
3913.description: Transforms into Elite: Shadow Captain to launch an Electro Bomb at the designated target, dealing AoE Attack DMG and [interrupting (#3000)] the target's actions. Upon the skill cast, the DMG dealt and healing of your Expertise Skill are increased for a period.

3914.name: Goblin Guard
3914.description: Summons Elite: Goblin Guard to perform multiple sword energy attacks forward, dealing Attack DMG. Sword energy hits will reduce the target's Armor. (The effect cannot stack, and only one effect of the same type will be effective.) Upon the skill cast, your Block DMG reduction is increased for a period.

3915.name: Goblin Warrior
3915.description: Summons Elite: Goblin Warrior to shoot in a fan-shaped area in front, dealing Attack DMG. Upon the skill cast, your Luck and Lucky Strike Chance are increased for a period.

3917.name: Shadow Commander
3917.description: Summons Elite: Shadow Commander to execute a forward flurry of slashes, inflicting Attack DMG and [interrupting (#3000)] the target's actions. All Heavy Slash charges are consumed in the process to significantly amplify the DMG inflicted.

3920.name: Airona
3920.description: Summons Airona. After a brief cast, revives up to 4 nearby teammates. Weakness: Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s (Weakness effects are enhanced in party dungeons of Nightmare mode).

3921.name: Tina
3921.description: Summons Tina to channel the power of time, reducing the Skill CDs of yourself and up to 10 surrounding allies for a certain period. (Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s.)

3922.name: Olvera
3922.description: Summons Olvera to shuttle back and forth in a forward direction, drawing in enemies encountered along the path, dealing Attack DMG, and [interrupting (#3000)] their actions. When dealing DMG, there is a chance to inflict Seed of Lightning on the targets for 10s. Dealing DMG to targets with Seed of Lightning will cause an explosion (CD: 2s), dealing Magic DMG. Any target with Seed of Lightning defeated will reduce CD time by 20s.

3923.name: Muku Chief
3923.description: Summons Boss: Muku Chief to slam the ground around, dealing AoE Attack DMG. Holds 2 charges. Upon the skill cast, your Crit and Crit DMG are increased for a period.

3925.name: Mighty Colossus
3925.description: Transforms into Elite: Mighty Colossus to charge and deal Attack DMG. The longer you charge, the greater the effect on Resilience breaking. Each stack increases the Resilience Break done by 50%. (3 stacks at Tier 3 and 6 stacks at Tier 5.) Upon the skill cast, your Resilience Break Bonus is increased for a period.

3926.name: Storm Goblin King
3926.description: Summons Boss: Storm Goblin King to release a meteor shower at the target, dealing Magic DMG. Upon the skill cast, your Luck and DMG dealt and healing of Luck effects are increased for a period. Tier 5: While active, trigger​ all unlocked ​passive Luck effects​ from your Plains Battle Imagines.

3927.name: Jungle Goblin Warrior
3927.description: Summons Elite: Jungle Goblin Warrior and roars. Casts the skill, temporarily boosting Strength, empowering the next attack to deal bonus Attack DMG in a limited area, and [interrupting (#3000)] the target's actions.

3928.name: Muku Scout
3928.description: Summons Elite: Muku Scout to chase the target, dealing Attack DMG. Upon the skill cast, immediately gains full passive effects, and the stack count is doubled within 20s.

3929.name: Void Arachnocrab
3929.description: Transforms into Elite: Void Arachnocrab, and gains Invincibility for 5s.

3930.name: Brigand Guard Captain
3930.description: Transforms into Elite: Brigand Guard Captain to grant Earth Shield, recovering a percentage of lost HP when you are attacked, up to 9 times. During this, your Endurance is increased.

3934.name: Brigand Scout Leader
3934.description: Summons Elite: Brigand Scout Leader to execute continuous attacks on the designated target, dealing Attack DMG and [interrupting (#3000)] their actions. Upon the skill cast, your Agility is increased for a period.

3935.name: Golden Juggernaut
3935.description: Transforms into Boss: Golden Juggernaut, granting yourself and 10 allies Shield. When dealing DMG, the shielded targets generate Thunderstrike (CD: 0.5s), and the DMG dealt depends on the friendly ATK. (This effect cannot stack and only one will be effective.)

3936.name: Lizardman Mage
3936.description: Summons Elite: Lizardman Mage to conjure the Water of Silence at the target's location, dealing Magic DMG and inflicting [Slow (#3011)]. Upon the skill cast, your Ice Bonus is increased for a period.

3937.name: Lizardman Hunter
3937.description: Summons Elite: Lizardman Hunter to chant briefly, dealing Magic DMG. Upon the skill cast, your Luck and Lucky Strike Chance are increased for a period.

3938.name: Phantom Arachnocrab
3938.description: Summons Boss: Phantom Arachnocrab and transforms into a cocoon. Following a brief delay, the cocoon bursts, dealing Attack DMG and [interrupting (#3000)] the actions of the affected target. Your Mastery is increased for a period.

3939.name: Great Warhog
3939.description: Summons Elite: Great Warhog to release a Lightning Orb forward, dealing Attack DMG. Upon the skill cast, your Light Bonus is increased for a period.

3940.name: Storm Goblin Warrior
3940.description: Summons Elite: Storm Goblin Warrior to continuously release Whirlwind Slash, dealing Attack DMG and pulling in all surrounding units. Upon the skill cast, your Wind Bonus is increased for a period.

3941.name: Void Bzzar
3941.description: Transforms into Elite: Void Bzzar for a period of time, during which you can release stings and projectiles.

3942.name: Venobzzar Incubator
3942.description: Summons Boss: Venobzzar Incubator to continuously attack surrounding units, dealing Attack DMG. Each attack inflicts Vulnerability on the target, and your DMG dealt to the target is increased. (This effect cannot stack and only one will be effective.)

3943.name: Iron Fang
3943.description: Summons Boss: Iron Fang to deliver AoE Attack DMG to nearby enemies, inflicting a 100% [Wound (#3004)] on all affected targets for 15s.

3944.name: Celestial Flier
3944.description: Summons Boss: Celestial Flier to charge forward, dealing Ice Attack DMG and [interrupting (#3000)] the targets' actions. After casting, your Haste is increased for a period of time.

3945.name: Lizardman King
3945.description: Summons Boss: Lizardman King to deal Ice Attack DMG to nearby enemies and [Silence (#3001)] them for 10s.

3946.name: Goblin King
3946.description: Resonates with the power of Boss: Goblin King, summoning 1–3 goblins at random to cast skills. Always summons 1 from Elite: Goblin Guard or Elite: Goblin Warrior. Has a chance to additionally summon 1 Elite: Jungle Goblin Warrior. Has a chance to summon 1 from Elite: Storm Goblin Axe or Boss: Storm Goblin King. Has a 30% chance to summon the Boss.

3947.name: Muku Vanguard
3947.description: Summons Elite: Muku Vanguard to charge forward, dealing Attack DMG. Upon the skill cast, your Thunder Bonus is increased for a period.

3948.name: Rorola
3948.description: Summons Rorola, resonating with the power of ancestors to gain a damage boost for some time. Also, every 10 hits on targets grant an additional damage boost, stacking up to 5 times. Once the cap is reached, subsequent hits extend the duration of the additional boost (the duration of the Base DMG boost does not extend). Each extension adds 3s, with a maximum of 5 extensions. At the same time, grants the Life Steal effect, restoring HP equal to a portion of damage dealt (the duration can extend). This skill holds 2 charges.

3949.name: Dorothy
3949.description: Transforms into Dorothy, replacing basic attack modules and gaining [Artisan's Power (#1210)]. Passive: Dealing damage has a 40% chance to trigger Chain Lightning (trigger interval: at least 0.5s). ① Charges and fires a powerful shot at the target, dealing Attack DMG. Each additional charge increases the damage by 150%. ② Leaps into the air and launches a Thunderstorm Bolt at the target, dealing Attack DMG and creating a Thunderstorm Zone at the target for 7s. Thunderstorm Zone deals Attack DMG per second to enemies within and [slows (#3011)] them. ③ Continuously unleashes Thunder Tracers, dealing Attack DMG and inflicting [Paralysis (#3008)] on hit. ④ Fires an Oblivion Bomb, which explodes after traveling a distance or upon impact, dealing Attack DMG.

3950.name: Boyce
3950.description: Summons Boyce to create a field of frost by concentrating ice power, dealing Ice Magic DMG. After casting, your ATK is increased for a period of time. Each cast of a Special Attack grants an additional increase, stacking up to 5 times. At max stacks, gain a bonus to Attack SPD and Casting SPD. Performing a Special Attack extends this bonus's duration by 3s, up to a max of 5 times (The ATK bonus's duration is not affected). This skill holds 2 charges.

3951.name: Fafala
3951.description: Summons Fafala to create a field. You and allies within the field gain Final DMG Reduction and Super Armor. When you deal damage from inside the field, inflict bonus damage based on a percentage of your DEF (can trigger at most once every 1s). When you take damage, reduce the CD of this Skill by 1s (can trigger at most once every 2s). [This effect does not stack. Only one instance of this effect can be active at a time.

3952.name: Blackstone Captain
3952.description: Summons Boss: Blackstone Captain to ignite flames centered on yourself, dealing Fire Attack DMG. After casting, your Attack SPD and Casting SPD are increased for a period of time.

3953.name: Goblin Chief
3953.description: Summons Boss: Goblin Chief to briefly charge up and unleash a forward blade wave that deals Attack DMG. After casting, your Expertise Skill's DMG and healing are increased for a period of time. During this time, dealing damage with an Expertise Skill reduces the CD of this Skill by 0.3s (can trigger at most once every 1s).

3954.name: Crimson Foxen
3954.description: Summons Boss: Crimson Foxen to spin and pounce on the target, dealing Attack DMG. After casting, your Companion ATK is increased for a period of time.

3955.name: Cabbage Kingpin
3955.description: Summons Boss: Cabbage Kingpin to briefly charge up and slam the ground with a hammer, dealing Attack DMG. After casting, your passive effect is locked to the displayed sigil for 20s, and its effect is increased by 100%-150%.

3956.name: Flamehorn
3956.description: Summons Boss: Flamehorn to repeatedly ram the target with its horns, dealing Attack DMG. Grants a Luck effect: Triggering a Lucky Strike causes an explosion at the target's location, dealing Magic DMG (cooldown: 0.1s), and immediately grants the Absolute Luck effect. For the duration, Absolute Luck's cooldown becomes 5s.

3957.name: Basilisk
3957.description: Summons Boss: Basilisk to spin toward the target, dealing Attack DMG. After casting, grants an All-Element Bonus to you and up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates) for a period of time. (Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s)

3958.name: Bluespine Lizard
3958.description: Summons Elite: Bluespine Lizard to breathe frost forward, dealing Attack DMG to targets in the area. After casting, increases Versatility for a period of time.

3959.name: Blackstone Commander
3959.description: Summons Elite: Blackstone Commander to call down lightning from the sky, dealing Magic DMG. For a period of time after the skill is cast, when you deal damage, you will also deal additional Attack DMG to the target equal to a percentage of your Armor (can trigger at most once every 1s).

3960.name: Blackstone Vanguard
3960.description: Transforms into Elite: Blackstone Vanguard to perform a spinning attack that deals Fire Attack DMG. Every stack of Blade Intent allows for an additional spin (up to 15 stacks). This damage benefits from all types of elemental bonuses and is not affected by passive effects.

3961.name: Goblin Trickster
3961.description: Summons Elite: Goblin Trickster to channel for a long time before dealing massive AoE Magic DMG. (This skill damages enemies and up to 20 allies!)

3962.name: Goblin Shaman
3962.description: Summons Elite: Goblin Shaman to briefly channel before summoning an exploding magic orb. The explosion deals Magic DMG to targets in the area and heals up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates). After casting, for 20s, you deal damage every 2s to the surrounding area equal to 50% of the self-healing from your Class Skills.

3963.name: Blackfire Foxen
3963.description: Summons Elite: Blackfire Foxen to pounce on, bite, and then swipe its tail at the target, dealing Attack DMG. After casting, your Mastery is increased for a period of time.

3964.name: Gloomy Cabbage
3964.description: Summons Elite: Gloomy Cabbage to briefly charge up and swing a greatsword, dealing Attack DMG to targets in the area. After casting, your Crit and Crit DMG are increased for a while (the values fluctuate based on the Cabbage sigil).

3965.name: Ruthless Cabbage
3965.description: Summons Elite: Ruthless Cabbage to randomly call down 1-3 bolts of simulated lightning, dealing Magic DMG to targets in the area.

3966.name: Emerald Caprahorn
3966.description: Summons Elite: Emerald Caprahorn to fire two consecutive projectiles, dealing Attack DMG to targets in the area. After casting, your Haste is increased for a period of time.

3968.name: Denvel
3968.description: Summons Denvel to attract nearby monsters and deal Attack DMG. After casting, grants a temporary enhancement: the user takes damage equal to 0.1% of Max HP every 0.2s and gains a DMG boost, with an additional boost for every 100,000 Max HP (Total base and extra DMG boost is capped, and the Max HP requirement is adjusted each season). This skill holds 2 charges.

3969.name: Igoreus
3969.description: Summons Igoreus to deal Attack DMG. Holds 2 charges. After casting, your Crit is temporarily increased. Any base Crit Rate exceeding 60% is converted into a Crit DMG boost at a set ratio.

3970.name: Plague Nappo
3970.description: Summons Plague Nappo. The Nappo's attack method and skill effects change based on the type of skill cast previously. If cast directly or after a Special Attack, summons Stormblade Nappo to deal AoE Attack DMG once, and reduces the current Resonance Skill's CD by 81.25%. If cast after an Expertise Skill, summons Marksman Nappo to deal Attack DMG to a single target, and reduces the current Resonance Skill's CD by 68.75%. If cast after an Ultimate, summons Wind Knight Nappo to deal Attack DMG once, reduces the current Resonance Skill's CD by 25%, and temporarily increases your DMG. If cast after another Resonance Skill, summons Beat Performer Nappo to reduce the CD of the previously cast Resonance Skill (excluding this one).

3971.name: Kartgriff
3971.description: Summons Kartgriff to deal Magic DMG. After casting, temporarily grants a Main Stats and Healing Received boost to you and up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates). (Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s.)

3972.name: Predator Spider
3972.description: Summons Boss: Predator Spider to deal Attack DMG. After casting, your passive ATK bonus is temporarily enhanced according to your Mastery Percentage. Every 5% Mastery grants extra ATK for each passive stack (up to a max limit).

3973.name: Rebel King
3973.description: Summons Boss: Rebel King to deal Attack DMG. After casting, temporarily grants full passive stacks, with the effect multiplied by 2.

3974.name: Void Watcher
3974.description: Summons Boss: Void Watcher, dealing Magic DMG and occupying an area for a period of time. You and your teammates within the area gain increased ATK, Attack SPD, and Casting SPD. The effect on yourself is multiplied by 2.5. (Does not stack; only one of the same effect may be active.)

3975.name: Ridge Fang
3975.description: Summons Boss: Ridge Fang to deal Attack DMG. After casting, instantly resets Survival Instinct CD. You remain Invigorated temporarily, and your Armor and Max HP are increased.

3976.name: Bloodthirsty Furball
3976.description: Summons Boss: Bloodthirsty Furball to deal Attack DMG. For a period of time after casting, every time your Class Skills and Luck effect deal damage, they add extra damage on top of the skill's base value, equal to a certain percentage of your ATK.

3977.name: Killer Arachnocrab
3977.description: Summons Elite: Killer Arachnocrab to deal Attack DMG. After casting, you gain full passive stacks for a period of time, during which they do not decrease.

3978.name: Verdant Fang
3978.description: Summons Elite: Verdant Fang to deal Attack DMG. For a period of time after casting, each Class Skill used reduces your remaining Ultimate CD (triggers up to once every 1s).

3979.name: Man-Eating Furball
3979.description: Summons Elite: Man-Eating Furball to deal Attack DMG. After casting, your Fire Bonus is temporarily increased.

3980.name: Dogorman
3980.description: Summons Elite: Dogorman, dealing Attack DMG equal to a percentage of your HP. After casting, your HP is also temporarily increased.

3981.name: Sanctuary Eye
3981.description: Summons Elite: Sanctuary Eye to deal Attack DMG. After casting, grants a Shield to yourself and up to 10 nearby allies for a period of time (prioritizes teammates).

3982.name: Lucy
3982.description: Transform into Celestial Spirit Mage - Lucy, replacing your skill set while gaining [Ability Conversion (#1219)]. Passive: Dealing damage converts 50% of the damage dealt into healing for up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates). 1. Fleuve d'Étoiles: Manifests the Fleuve d'Étoiles and swings it continuously, dealing Light Magic DMG to targets. 2. Celestial Guardian: Harnesses the power of Celestial Spirits to grant a shield lasting 20s to up to 10 allies within range (prioritizing teammates). Simultaneously inflicts debuffs on up to 5 enemies within range, reducing ATK, applying Vulnerability, and reducing Element Resistance for 10s. 3. Aqua Metria: Draws upon the power of Aquarius to unleash waves forward, dealing Water Magic DMG to targets in their path, with an additional 50% of the damage dealt converted into healing.

3983.name: Natsu
3983.description: Transform into Fire Dragon Slayer - Natsu, replacing your skill set while gaining [Ability Conversion (#1217)]. Passive: Casting skills other than an Ultimate Skill grants stacks of Dragon Flame based on the skill type. Every 10 stacks of Dragon Flame automatically converts into 1 stack of Dragon Force. Dragon Force can stack up to 5 times. Each stack of Dragon Force grants a Fire Bonus. 1. Fire Dragon's Iron Fist: Charges briefly before unleashing a blazing punch forward, dealing Fire Attack DMG and accumulating 5 stacks of Dragon Flame. 2. Fire Dragon's Wing Attack: Leaps fiercely and dashes forward, dealing Fire Attack DMG and accumulating 5 stacks of Dragon Flame. 3. Fire Dragon's Roar: Gathers the power of flames to spew a massive blast of fire forward, dealing Fire Attack DMG. If at max Dragon Force stacks, consumes all stacks of Dragon Force to gain CD reduction for Natsu's skills and a Fire Bonus. This effect persists for the duration of the current transformation and can stack up to 3 times.

104.description: Increases Crit DMG of Frost Lance by {p1}. When consuming Frost Crystal, increases Blizzard DMG by {p2} for 10s, stacking up to 10 times

114.description: Granite Fury has a {p1} chance to trigger Weakness Strike

113.description: DMG of Sandshroud, Star Shatter and its enhanced skill (Starfall) +35%. Class Skills have a 18% fixed chance to generate 1 Sand Crystal when dealing damage to the current target.

119.description: While Heroic Melody is active, Fire Bonus +5%.

122.description: Casting Reckoning or Inferno Reckon grants Glimmering: Damage +8%, Armor +12% for 5s.

129.description: Flowing Splendor Slash's Final DMG is enhanced based on the target's lost HP. When the target's HP falls below 30%, the Final DMG increase reaches a maximum of 300%.

102.description: After 2 uses of Divine Sickle, your next Divine Sickle triggers 1 instance of Reversal Blade, which counts as Divine Sickle.

107.description: Casting Galeform​ automatically triggers 1 shot of ​Drake Cannon​. ​Vortex Strike now has 2 charges.

108.description: After casting Galeform​, the next Skyfall and Instant Edge gain Wind DMG +70%.

114.description: Casting Granite reduces the remaining CD on Sandshroud by 0.6s. If Sandshroud is active, its duration is extended by 0.6s.

116.description: Storm Arrow grants +1.5% Agility on hit. Lasts 8s and stacks up to 5 times.

117.description: While Focus is active, Crit DMG +50%.

120.description: Within 5s after casting Healing Beat, the final healing of Healing Melody is increased by 8%. Within 8s after casting Fivefold Crescendo, the final healing of Heroic Melody is increased by 16%.

122.description: While Aegis Ward is active, Glimmering effects are doubled and additionally convert 20% of damage dealt into a Radiant Shield.
